1011.title: Danger From Above
1011.description: Talk with Kairon. Talk with Hynops. Remove the floating Abyss fragments(3). Talk with Kairon. Order: The citadel is endangered by fragments that have been appearing from the Abyss. Help Kairon, who is desperately trying to remove them before they cause injury.

1012.title: Masked Loiterers
1012.description: Talk with Spiros. Scout around Verteron Citadel for suspicious strangers. Scouting completed! Report back to Spiros. Collect the Revolutionary Symbol and take them to Spiros. PlayerOrder: You heard strangers were lurking around northwest of the citadel. Meet Spiros to hear about the specifics.

1013.title: Hunting Lepharist Revolutionaries
1013.description: Talk with Abolos. Defeat Thiefs in Belbua's Farm. (10) Talk with Abolos. Defeat Cavil of the Lepharist Revolutionaries (1). Talk with Abolos. Order: Abolos is planning to purge Belbua's Farm of the Lepharist Revolutionaries. Go to him.

1014.title: Odium in the Dukaki Settlement
1014.description: Talk with Leto. Defeat Dukaki Miners (9). Talk with Leto. Take the Striking Rod from Tursin Bigmouth and ring the bell, then take potion from Overseer Redtum and pour it into the cauldron. PlayerTalk with Leto. Talk with Spatalos. Order: Receive instructions from Leto to stop the Dukaki Kobolds from refining Odium.

1015.title: Frillneck Hunt
1015.description: Talk with Leto. Thin the Rakeclaw Frillneck population (7). Report back to Leto. Kill some Giant Rakeclaw Frillnecks (12). Talk with Leto. Order: The Southern Tolbas Forest is in danger. Leto has a mission for you.

1016.title: Source of the Pollution
1016.description: Talk with Geolus. Find Lepios, the missing investigator. Bring the contaminated water sample to Geolus. Borrow the "Guide to Rare Poisons" from Dimos. Bring the contaminated water sample to Jumentis. Meet Quintus and find out the cause of the contamination. Go to Hygea and receive Yustiel's Tear. Talk with Geolus. Defeat Poisonous Bubblegut. Talk with Kato's spirit. Report back to Spatalos. Order: Help Geolus and stop the spread of Tolbas Forest pollution.

1017.title: Held Sacred
1017.description: Talk with Lunax. Retrieve the Sacred Images of Kaisinel from Tursin Holy Ground Guards or Captured Tursin Guards, or enter and explore through Haramel for them, then bring your findings to Lunax. PlayerOrder: Find the Tursin Krall that attacked the temple, retrieve the Sacred Icons, and return them to Lunax.

1018.title: Mark of Vengeance
1018.description: Collect 10 Krall Marks and take them to Spatalos. PlayerOrder: Kill Tursin Krall to collect 10 Krall Marks.

1019.title: Flying Reconnaissance
1019.description: Talk with Estino. Use the transformation potion at the entrance of the Tursin Outpost and scout the base. Scouting completed! Talk with Spatalos. Talk with Meteina. Lure the Tursin Loudmouth Boss to Meteina. Talk with Meteina. Destroy the flags of the Tursin Outpost (3). Use a flint and set fire to the Tursin Totem Pole of Tursin Garrison. Terminate either Ziloota the Seer or High Priest Munuka. Talk with Spatalos. Lure out Tursin Loudmouth Boss again. Order: Scout the Tursin Outpost for Odium. Meet Estino.

1020.title: Sealing the Abyss Gate
1020.description: Talk with Spatalos. Enter the Sealed Space via the Abyss Gate in Kraka's Den. Obtain the Seal of Kuninasha and destroy the Abyss Gate. Report to Spatalos. Order: Speak with Spatalos to receive a secret mission of vital importance to Elysea.

1021.title: Trandila's Eggs
1021.description: Talk with Leto. Go to Southern Tolbas Forest and kill Trandila (1). Talk with Leto. Order: Receive precise instructions from Leto before killing Trandila.

1022.title: Krall Desecration
1022.description: Talk with Lunax. Defeat Veteran Tursin Smackstoppers and Tursin Senior Command Soldiers(5). Talk with Lunax. Order: Help Lunax by defeating the veteran guard from the Tursin Garrison who have been sending scouts to the Miraju's Holy Ground.

1023.title: A Nest of Lepharists
1023.description: Speak with Spatalos. Go to the Verteron Observatory and talk to Khidia. Investigate the Mysterious Shipwreck. Scouting completed! Talk with Khidia. Go to the Mysterious Shipwreck, kill Captain Kinsgreen, search his body for clues, and return to Khidia. Go back to Verteron Citadel and talk with Spatalos. Meet Spatalos to receive orders about investigating the Lepharist Revolutionaries.

1031.title: The Manduri's Secret
1031.description: Talk with Aurelius. Hunt Manduri (6). Report to Aurelius. Talk with Archelaos. Find Paper Glider. Find Melginie. Escort Melginie to Celestine. Talk with Celestine. Report to Aurelius. Order: The Manduri have become increasingly violent and have started to attack the Eltnen residents. Meet Aurelius and see what needs doing.

1032.title: A Ruler's Duty
1032.description: Talk to Phomona. Talk to Demro. Talk to Lodas. Find a Kerubian Bucket and fill it with Uncontaminated Water from the waterfall. PlayerBring the water to Lodas. Talk to Demro. Talk to Phomona. Order: The Elim are struggling with the gradual desertification of the Eltnen region. Meet with Phomona and find out what she knows.

1033.title: Sataloca's Heart
1033.description: Talk to Diomedes. Go to Sataloca's Tomb and talk to Kimeia. Obtain as many Acheron Drake Fangs as you can within the time limit. Talk to Kimeia. Report the results of your test to Diomedes. Order: Kimeia, a Daeva guarding Sataloca's heart, is looking for you. Talk with Diomedes and receive your orders.

1034.title: Disappearing Aether
1034.description: Talk with Valerius. Talk with Lakaias. Check the condition of the Artifact. Report to Lakaias. Kill Ancient Caryatids, and bring any clues you find to Lakaias. PlayerTalk with Valerius. Order: Valerius received a report that something is wrong at the Outpost Ruins. Meet him and listen to the details.

1035.title: Refreshing the Springs
1035.description: Talk with Gaia. Talk with Ophelos. Retrieve a Life Bead and put it into the Laquepin Life Stone. PlayerTalk with Ophelos. Talk with Castor. Talk with Corybantes. Talk with Heratos. Go to the Desert Life Stone and insert the Life Bead within three minutes. Talk with Heratos. Talk with Sirink. Restore the Mystic Spring by putting the Bead into the Temple Life Stone. Talk with Sirink. Talk with Gaia. Order: The Mystic Springs that Lady Yustiel created have all dried out. Go to Gaia to receive instructions on how to help.

1036.title: Kaidan Prisoner
1036.description: Talk to Malonimus. Talk to Taera. Find Hierni. Find the Sentry's Key and rescue Hierni. PlayerTalk to Captured Gardugu. Talk to Mabangtah. Talk to Telemachus. Order: Someone has been abducted by the Kaidan Krall. Go to Malonimus for your orders.

1037.title: Secrets of the Temple
1037.description: Go to the Golden Bough Garrison and talk with Castor. Talk with Axelion. Collect Wall Fragments and bring them to Axelion. PlayerRestore the Flower Wall. Restore the Lightning Wall. Restore the Wave Wall. Restore the Wind Wall. Restore the Fire Wall. Report to Castor. Order: The Golden Bough Legion is exploring the Eracus Temple Cavern. Meet Brigade General Castor and receive his instructions.

1038.title: The Shadow's Command
1038.description: Search the Eracus Temple Cavern. Talk with Actaeon. Investigate the whereabouts of Priest Philipemos. You found the diary. Report to Actaeon. Find the Torn Pages of the diary and bring them to Actaeon. PlayerGo to Eltnen Observatory and talk with Dionera. Get rid of Hippolytus (1). Report to Dionera. Order: Strange Aetheric energy is emerging from the Artifact in the floor of Eracus Temple Cavern. Go investigate the Artifact.

1039.title: Something in the Water
1039.description: Talk with Asclepius. Collect Brook Water and take it to Jumentis. Report to Asclepius. Get rid of some Lepharist Revolutionaries. Scout Vaegir (3) Scout Fighter (3) Report to Asclepius. Order: There is a problem in Agairon Village. Meet Centurion Asclepius, who was dispatched to the village.

1040.title: Scouting the Scouts
1040.description: Talk to Tumblusen. Get rid of the Kaidan Scouts to the southeast of the Observatory (3). Talk to Tumblusen. Report to Telemachus. Talk to Mabangtah. Talk to Targatu. Kill the Guard at the Watchtower and scout the Kaidan Headquarters (1). Return to Targatu. Talk to Mabangtah. Report to Tumblusen. Order: There's a problem near the Observatory. Speak to Tumblusen to find out the details.

1041.title: A Dangerous Artifact
1041.description: Talk with Telemachus. Go to Lepharist Bastion and find the Civil Engineer. Escort the Civil Engineer to either the Secret Exit or the Forgotten Passage. Report to Telemachus. Talk with Xenophon. Talk with Yuditio. Report to Telemachus. Talk with Laigas. Blast the Stolen Artifact with the Aether Explosive. Talk with Laigas. Report to Telemachus. Find out how the Lepharist Revolutionaries are using the Artifact. Meet Telemachus to receive your mission.

1042.title: Keeper of the Kaidan Key
1042.description: Talk with Tumblusen. Find out from the Crack Kaidan Skullcrackers, Kaidan Blocker Bosses, and Crack Kaidan Captains who is holding the Abyss Gate Key. Alternatively, search Strong Document Box. Kill either Chaoslord Kalabar or Shaman Kalabar, and take the Abyss Gate Key to Telemachus. PlayerTumblusen has something to tell you about the Abyss Gate. Go to the Eltnen Observatory and meet him.

1043.title: Balaur Conspiracy
1043.description: Talk with Telemachus. Talk with Mabangtah. Travel through the Eltnen Abyss Gate to meet Kimeia. Protect Kimeia from Balaur. Talk with Kimeia. Report to Telemachus. The Kaidan Krall have opened an Abyss Gate. Meet Telemachus to receive your mission.

1051.title: The Ruins of Roah
1051.description: Talk with Sarantus. Talk with Ibelia. Find the Engraved Stone Tablet in Vaizel's Peak. Take the engraving to Ibelia. Talk with Sarantus. Talk with Ipikio. Talk with Calon. Find the Stone Plate from Ruins of Roah and bring it to Calon. PlayerReport to Sarantus. Order: Talk to Sarantus to receive a mission involving the ruins of Heironopolis.

descriptionLinks.name: Stone Plate from Ruins of Roah

1052.title: Root of the Rot
1052.description: Talk with Aphesius. Collect the roots of Lumbering Agrints and Greenclaw Rotrons and then bring them to Aphesius. PlayerTalk with Mersephon. Talk with Trajanus. Order: It seems a strange thing is happening to the trees and the Elim. Let's hear the detailed story from Aphesius.

1053.title: The Klaw Threat
1053.description: Talk with Senea. Bring the living cells of Klaw Defenders and Klaw Sentinels to Senea. PlayerDestroy Klawspawn to lure out and kill Queen Taklaw (1). Talk with Barzon. Order: Klaws are threatening the ecological system of the Poya Jungle. Assist Ecologist Senea in finding a solution.

1054.title: Power of the Elim
1054.description: Talk with Trajanus. Talk with Voice of Arbolu. Meet Daminu and receive his essence. Meet Lodas and receive his essence. Take the essences to Voice of Arbolu. Destroy Splintered Rotrons and Motheaten Agrints and bring their souls to Voice of Arbolu. PlayerOrder: Help Trajanus deal with the Agrints and Rotrons.

1055.title: Eternal Rest
1055.description: Talk with Tessia. Find Kacias. Collect the bones of Manor Worker and take them to Kacias. PlayerBury Urn of the Deceased at Empty Stone Coffin. Report the result to Kacias. Report the result to Tessia. Order: Tessia asked you to investigate an undead who is harrasing passersby at Medies Manor West.

1056.title: Lepharist Poison Research
1056.description: Talk with Sofne. Talk with Finn. Take a poison sample from Synthesis Researcher Twisk and bring it to Jumentis. PlayerGet rid of Chairman Garnis at the Lepharist research center (1). Report the result to Jumentis. Report the result to Thrasymedes. The Lepharists are conducting strange experiments. Speak with Sofne and see what you can do to help.

1057.title: Creating a Monster
1057.description: Talk with Barzon. Talk with Nargis. Find Fallen Lapontos. Bring Lapontos' Journal to Barzon. PlayerFind the entrance of Aetherogenetics Lab in the northwestern part of Lepharist Research Center and infiltrate into it. Destroy the Giant Flasks in the bio experiment lab of the secret laboratory (3). Kill RM-78c in Ormenon's room (1). Search Lepharist Secret Safe. Escape from the secret laboratory and report the result to Perento. Barzon wants to know what the Lepharists are researching. Report to him for orders.

1058.title: Aether Insanity
1058.description: Talk with Mabangtah. Talk with Sarantus. Kill Fanatic Kralls and Captain Kabaltu, and bring the evidence to Sarantus. PlayerOrder: Mabangtah sent a message asking for your assistance. Go to Eltnen and meet with him.

1059.title: The Archon of Storms
1059.description: Talk with Sulates. Talk with Anto. Destroy Cursed Obelisk (1). Talk with Anto. Talk with Maximus. Burn incense at Patema Geyser for Myanee. Report the result to Sulates. Sulates has a favor to ask you. Go and see him.

1062.title: Indratu Legion
1062.description: Talk with Perento. Talk with Piros. Find Lamidros. Destroy Balaur Guardian Stones (5). Dispose of Guardian Drafala (1). Report the result to Perento. Order: Heiron's leaders plan to strike a blow against the invading Balaur. Go to the fortress and meet Brigade General Perento.

1063.title: Brigadier Indratu
1063.description: Talk with Perento. Enter the Indratu Fortress through the Heiron Abyss Gate and vanquish Brigadier Indratu (1). Escape from the fortress through the Indratu Legion Abyss Gate and report back to Perento. Report the result to Fasimedes. Order: The Indratu Legion must be expunged, once and for all. Speak to Brigade General Perento.

1071.title: Speaking Balaur
1071.description: Talk with Ventus. Talk with Kunberunerk. Talk with Mapirerk. Talk with Kuenunerk. Talk with Kunberunerk. Drink the potion. Talk with Kunberunerk. Talk with Ventus. Order: Apparently, you have something important to learn in order to carry out missions in the Abyss. See Ventus for the details.

1072.title: Abyss Training
1072.description: Talk with Eulos. Learn about the Aetheric Field surrounding fortresses from Sileni. Learn about the Castle Gates and Gate Restoration Stones from Adrastea. Learn about the Guardian General from Lachesis. Learn about Artifacts from Erdias. Learn about Kisks from Jenirius. Learn about the Dredgion from Larentia. Talk with Claudia. Order: You need to receive a basic education before you can battle in the Abyss. Go to Eulos and ask about lessons.

1073.title: Saving Elyos Captives
1073.description: Talk with Sakmis. Talk with Nereus. Talk with Dactyl. Locate the Captured Elyos Prisoner. Escort Captured Elyos Prisoners to the Magic Ward. Report back to Nereus. Order: Elyos soldiers are being held captive on the Isle of Disgrace in the Sulfur Archipelago. See Sakmis to get more information, then go rescue them.

1074.title: Fragment of Memory 1
1074.description: Talk with Michalis. Go to Poeta and talk to Pernos. Go to Reshanta and talk to Lugbug. Activate the Artifact of the Inception. Talk withLugbug. Order: Michalis has something to tell you about your lost memory. Go to Teminon Fortress and see Michalis.

1075.title: New Wings
1075.description: Talk with Tellus. Find the Tigraki Island and see Agemonerk. Find Raithor who has gone missing. Talk with Raithor. Destroy Ranx Archer and talk to Raithor. Talk with Agemonerk. Order: See Tellus in Teminon Landing for important information.

1076.title: Fragment of Memory 2
1076.description: Talk with Yuditio. Talk with Nestor. Get the Blessed Orb Components and bring them to Diana.Player Talk with Nestor. See the past in your mind's eye. Report the result to Nestor. Report the result to Aithra. Report the result to Boreas. Order: Yuditio says he has something to ask you in private. See Yuditio in Teminon Landing.

1077.title: Fragment of Memory 3
1077.description: Talk with Boreas. Go to Theobomos and talk with Gaix. Go to Heiron and talk with Finn. Go to Azoturan through Azoturan Fortress Passage, and contact Acestes. Talk with Peitho. Find and kill the betrayer Betrayer Icaronix. Talk with Acestes. Report the result to Yuditio. Order: Boreas has something to tell you regarding Icaronix. Go and see Boreas.

1091.title: A Request From Atropos
1091.description: Meet Atropos, the Aetheric Field Protector of Theobomos. Order: Meet Atropos, the Aetheric Field Protector of Theobomos.

1092.title: Josnack's Dilemma
1092.description: Talk with Atropos. Talk with Josnack. Get rid of stones so they can restore the statue. Stone above the Statue [%11] Stone on the Statue Platform [%14] Talk with Atropos. Destroy the Eternal Flames, and collect their Soul Pieces from the Burnt Zombies. Take them to Atropos. PlayerReceive a reward from Atropos. Order: Atropos had something to ask you about restoring relics. Go to the Observatory and meet Atropos.

1093.title: The Calydon Ruins
1093.description: Talk with Atropos. Go to Sanctum and talk with Hestia. Go to Theobomos and talk with Jamanok. Go to Broken Fang Bridge and transform into a Calydon. Make a rubbed copy of First Calydon Stone Plate. Make a rubbed copy of Second Calydon Stone Plate. Make a rubbed copy of Third Calydon Stone Plate. Take the rubbed copies to Serimnir. Talk to Serimnir. Report the result to Atropos. Order: Atropos told you she had a mission for you. Go to the Observatory and meet Atropos.

1094.title: Project Drakanhammer
1094.description: Go to Sanctum and talk with Nestor. Go to Theobomos and talk with Atropos. Find Research Diary at Port Anangke to get a possible lead about the secret laboratory [%8]. Get rid of Four Weapons of Theobomos to get the keys to the laboratory, and enter Theobomos Lab Entrance to find the Assistant's Research Diary. PlayerAfter reading Assistant's Journal, go to Sanctum and report to Nestor. Order: Nestor said he had something to tell you about Project Drakanhammer. Go to the Library of the Sages in Sanctum and meet Nestor.

1096.title: A Past Mission
1096.description: Go to Sanctum and talk with Lavirintos. Talk with Ludina. Go to Poeta and talk to Pernos. Lavirintos says he has something to tell you about your memories. Go to the Protectors Hall in Sanctum and meet him.

1097.title: Sword of Transcendence
1097.description: Talk with Pernos. Go to Sanctum and talk with Anusis. Procure the Special Materials and take them to Baoninerk in Reshanta. PlayerReturn to Poeta and talk to Pernos. Pernos says that you need a special weapon as your abilities aren't as great as they once were. Meet Anusis and seek his advice.

1098.title: Pearl of Protection
1098.description: Talk with Pernos. Accept the blessing of Daminu[%5]. Accept the blessing of Lodas[%8]. Accept the blessing of Arbolu[%11]. Accept the energy of Khidia[%14]. Accept the energy of Tumblusen[%17]. Accept the energy of Atropos[%20]. Accept the energy of Aphesius[%23]. Accept the energy of Jucleas[%26]. Accept the blessing of Morai[%29]. Accept the blessing of Gaia[%32]. Accept the blessing of Kimeia[%35]. Accept the blessing of Jamanok[%38]. Accept the blessing of Serimnir[%41]. Accept the blessing of Maximus[%44]. Take the marble to Pernos in Poeta. You need a strong spell of protection before you go to Karamatis. Infuse blessings from people you've encountered in your travels into the marble you received from Pernos.

1099.title: An Important Choice
1099.description: Talk with Pernos. Find Fissure of Destiny that connects to Karamatis and talk with Hermione. Proceed to Karamatis and defeat Orissan Legionary (50). Defeat Orissan (1). Activate the Artifact of Memory. Talk with Lephar. Report the result to Fasimedes. You are ready to recover your lost memory. Find the Fissure of Destiny and go to Karamatis.

1130.title: Summons to the Citadel
1130.description: Meet Brigade General Spatalos to receive Verteron campaign quests. Meet Brigade General Spatalos to receive the campaign quests for Verteron. Spatalos is inside the building that William guards.

1300.title: Orders from Telemachus
1300.description: Meet Telemachus, General of Eltnen Fortress, and receive your missions. Meet General Telemachus, commander of the Eltnen region, and receive your missions.

1489.title: Marfonda of Darkness
1489.description: Collect XXX and take them to XXX. PlayerTalk with % Talk with % Talk with % Quest Description Summary (keep it short in one line if possible)

1500.title: Orders From Perento
1500.description: Meet Brigade General Perento of New Heiron Gate to receive your mission. Go and receive your mission from Brigade General Perento in Heiron.

1919.title: Welcome to the Artisan's Hall
1919.description: Talk with Anusis. Go to the Artisans Hall and talk with Manuka.

2011.title: Fungus Among Us
2011.description: Talk with Valurion. Talk with Borender. Get rid of the Abyss Fungus (5). Talk with Valurion. Order: Pests from the Abyss threaten the health of Altgard's residents. Help Borender get rid of Abyss Fungens.

2012.title: Encroachers
2012.description: Talk with Meiyer. Defeat the Lepharist Revolutionaries hiding near the Altgard Ice Lake (4). Go back to Meiyer. Order: The Lepharist Revolutionaries are camped around Altgard Ice Lake. Get rid of them.

2013.title: A Dangerous Crop
2013.description: Talk with Loriniah. Scout the MuMu Farmland. Scouting completed! Talk with Loriniah. Burn the MuMu Carts in the MuMu Farmland (3). Talk with Loriniah. Defeat the Skurvs and Mau, gather Proof of Hunting, and bring it to Loriniah. PlayerOrder: Intelligence reports say that the MuMu tribe is growing Odella. Take the mission from Loriniah and scout the MuMu's farming field.

2014.title: Scout it Out
2014.description: Talk with Olenja. Search Manir's Dock and find out what the Lepharist Revolutionaries are looking for. Report the result to Olenja. Talk with Hunmir. Search the Lepharist Escort Wagon on the path to the Grave Robbers Den. Report the result to Nokir. Order: Meet Olenja and find out what the Lepharist Revolutionaries near Manir's Campsite are looking for.

2015.title: Take the Initiative
2015.description: Talk with Nokir. Get rid of the Lepharist Revolutionaries. Kill Comrade Sumarhon(1) Kill Grave Robbing Sentrys(5) Kill Grave Robbing Fencer(5) Report the result to Nokir. Order: Get rid of Sumarhon, leader of a Lepharist cell, and the grave robbers.

2016.title: Fear This
2016.description: Talk with Nokir. Go to the MuMu Village and get rid of the Black Claw Tribe (5). Go back to Nokir. Talk with Shania. Gather Arachna Poison Sacs and take them to Shania. PlayerGo to the MuMu Village, and pour the toxin into the Fresh Water Source. Mission completed! Report the result to Nokir. Order: Receive a mission from Nokir, and attack the MuMu who are refining Odella in the MuMu Village.

2017.title: Trespassers at the Observatory
2017.description: Talk with Aurtri. Go to the Lepharist Encampment and get rid of the Watch Bodyguards. (5). Go back to Aurtri. Take Tiamat's Sword from Sentinel Leader Gattban and bring it to Aurtri. PlayerReport the result to Valurion. Order: Meet Aurtri and get rid of the Lepharist Revolutionaries who threaten the Observatory.

2018.title: Reconstructing Impetusium
2018.description: Talk with Gulkalla. Destroy Hero Spirits. (3) Go back to Gulkalla. Bring Umkata's Three Tokens to Umkata's Grave, summon the spirit of Umkata, and destroy it. PlayerReport back to Gulkalla. Order: Meet Gulkalla and help him reconstruct Impetusium.

2019.title: Securing the Supply Route
2019.description: Talk with Neparinerk. Kill the Crimsontail Amphas. (3) Go back to Neparinerk. Deliver the tools to Banatisai. Order: Meet Neparinerk and help him get new tools to Impetusium.

2020.title: Keeping the Black Claw Tribe in Check
2020.description: Talk with Dellalont. Talk with Jolk. Fight the Black Claw Mau to ascertain their strength. (3). Go back to Jolk. Kill either High Spellshifter Abija or Shaman Gabacha and bring the evidence to Jolk. PlayerOrder: Meet Dellalont and receive a mission to keep the Black Claw Tribe in check.

2021.title: Know Your Enemy
2021.description: Talk with Taora. Transform into a Mau and examine the big totem in the Black Claw Outpost. Examination complete! Go back to Taora. Go to the Black Claw Outpost and destroy Zemurru's Totems (3). Report the result to Taora. Go back to Altgard Fortress and report the result to Suthran. Report to Taora that you failed to find the totem. Obtain Malodor Thorns and bring them to Taora. PlayerOrder: Meet Taora and figure out what the Black Claw Tribe are up to.

2022.title: Crushing the Conspiracy
2022.description: Talk with Suthran. Go to Zemurru's Grave and find the Abyss Gate. Then, go into the sealed area. Disrupt the Gate Guardian Stone, which maintains the Abyss Gate. Defeat Kuninasha. Destroy the Abyss Gate. Report the result to Suthran. Order: Talk to Brigade General Suthran and receive orders for a secret mission imperative to Altgard's very survival.

2031.title: Petrifying Elim
2031.description: Talk with Vili. Talk with Nabaru. Reclaim the Essence from Spriggan Gatherers and Spriggle Wardens and take it to Nabaru. PlayerListen to Nabaru. Use the Essence of Elim at the Hill of Belemu. Let Nabaru know what happened. Order: There is a request regarding the Elim. Meet with Centurion Vili.

2032.title: Guardian Spirit
2032.description: Talk with Bragi. Talk with Tofa. Gather Ancient Archon Weapons and an Ancient Archon Armor and take them to Tofa. PlayerListen to Tofa. Sprinkle the Tranquility Powder at the Execution Ground of Deltras. Report the result to Tofa. The Shadow Executor at the Desert Garrison is looking for some help. Go to Bragi to get the details.

2033.title: Destroying the Curse
2033.description: Talk with Urakon. Talk with Kellan. Gather Spiner Tails and take them to Kellan. PlayerListen to the story of Kellan. Meet Kimssi. Choose a Skurv to guide you. Throw the Cursed Necklace into the Boiling Lava. Report back to Kellan. Order: There is an important mission regarding a Cursed Necklace. See Urakon who patrols the Fortress entrance.

2034.title: The Hand Behind the Ice Claw
2034.description: Talk with Nina. Talk with Jorund. Make a fire in the Dead Fire at Altar of Trial to roast the Abex Meat to lure out the White Brow Tayga and kill it. Report the result to Jorund. Use your new title to enter the Aetheric Field and dispatch Protector Karhel. Report the result to Nina. Report the result to Aegir. Get the details from Nina about dealing with the Ice Claw Mau.

2035.title: The Three Keys
2035.description: Talk with Anund. Meet Bulagan. Enter the Sky Temple of Arkanis through the Water Room. Find the Keys and return to Bulagan. PlayerReport the result to Gelkugin. Order: There is an important mission regarding the Sky Temple of Arkanis. Go to Anund and get the details.

2036.title: A Captive Flame
2036.description: Talk with Gelkugin. Talk with Bulagan. Go into the Fire Temple Entrance, defeat the Chalice Guard Denlavis, for a clue to Agnita's prison. Find the Sacred Chalice Agnita is sealed in and take it to Gelkugin. PlayerBring Anund the happy news. Order: Agnita must be rescued. Talk to Gelkugin.

2037.title: The Protector of Nepra
2037.description: Talk with Tyr. Speak to Hreidmar. Go to Reshanta and see Ahin. Talk with Hreidmar. Spy on the Mist Mane Mau at the Altar of the Black Dragon. Scouting complete! Report to Hreidmar. Kill Spiritchaser Parunru (1). Report to Hreidmar. Tell the story to Tyr. Order: Aetheric Field Protector Tyr wants you to go and see Hreidmar.

2038.title: A Lost Daeva
2038.description: Talk with Mirka. Go to Wonshikutz's Laboratory and find Pagimkin. Dispose of Chairman Wonshikutz. Make it back to Mirka. Report the result to Kvasir. Order: There's been news about several missing Daevas. Go see Mirka.

2039.title: Allies Among Enemies
2039.description: Talk with Rikesh. Speak to Ananta. Rescue the Mau prisoners. Rescue Aknanti [%11]. Rescue Gaganti [%14]. Rescue Kogita [%17]. Talk with Ananta. Speak to Chieftain Chaikata. Order: To keep the Balaur in check, help the Silver Mane Mau. See Rikesh, the priest in Alsig Village.

2040.title: Kikananta's Loyalty
2040.description: Talk with Chieftain Chaikata. Meet Kikananta. Bring the Aether Key to Kikananta. PlayerReport the result to Chieftain Chaikata. Meet Rikesh. Report the result to Vili. Order: The chieftain of Silver Mane, Chaikata, has a request. Go and talk to him.

2041.title: Hold The Front Line
2041.description: Talk with Aegir. Meet Taisan. Pass through Morheim Abyss Gate and talk with Kargate. Protect Kargate from the Balaur. Speak to Kargate. Report back to Aegir. Order: It seems the Mist Mane Mau have opened the Abyss Gate. Go to General Aegir to receive your mission.

2051.title: Saving Beluslan Fortress
2051.description: Talk with Nerita. Talk with Bestla. Poke the Temporal Transfer Stone and see what's wrong with it. That wasn't supposed to happen! Better tell Bestla... Talk with Cavalorn in Pandaemonium. Go to Reshanta and talk with Haug. Collect Golden Corneas and a Greater Aether Gem and bring them to Haug. PlayerReport to Bestla. Install the Aether Booster in the Rift Artifact. Report to Nerita. Meet Brigade General Nerita about the problem of the collapsing fortress.

2052.title: An Undead Occupation
2052.description: Talk with Grundt. Talk with Gigrite. Hunt Pale Zombies (5). Report the result to Gigrite. Ask for help from Vanargand. Gather a Mosbear Claw, an (A) Group Kisk, and a Salix Log and bring them to Vanargand. PlayerPlay the flute near Beritra's Weapon. Report the result to Grundt. The undead problem in the Besfer Ghost Village is serious. Meet Grundt and find out the story.

2053.title: A Missing Father
2053.description: Talk with Mani. Talk with Paeru. Look for clues in the pamphlet. Investigate the Bridge of Heaven. This must be the Bridge of Heaven. Pick up Strahein's trail. Report back to Mani. Interrogate Hammel. Get the key from the Mine Supervisor, find the Secret Port Entrance, and save Strahein. PlayerReport to Mani. Talk with Mani about the mysterious disappearances around the fortress.

2054.title: Light up the Lighthouse
2054.description: Talk with Sleipnir. Talk with Baugi. Get a clue from Captain Hinden to find the Quartz Lens. PlayerFind the treasure chest and obtain Quartz Lens. Quartz Lens found! Install the lens in the Anair Lighthouse Light Source. Report the result to Sleipnir. Order: The Quartz Lens of Anair Lighthouse used to light the way to Alukina's Palace. Meet Sleipnir and hear its story.

2055.title: The Seiren's Treasure
2055.description: Talk with Sleipnir. Talk with Rubelik. Talk with Sleipnir. Find Esnu and make a deal with her. Remove Aika Deathsong and bring the key to Esnu. PlayerTalk again with Esnu and get the key to Golden Trumpet Temple. Report the results to Sleipnir. Sleipnir says that he noticed something odd about Captain Hinden's letter. Speak with him.

2056.title: Thawing Kurngalfberg
2056.description: Talk with Kistenian. Meet Etun, Anoramas, and Triminos, get their essences and bring them to Kistenian. PlayerGo to The Sacred Orchard and wake up Kasadrasil with the essence of Anoramas. Wake up Kasadrasil with the essence of Triminos. Wake up Kasadrasil with the essence of Etun. Report the result to Kistenian. Order: Kistenian, a Daeva of Flame, needs help to melt the frozen city of Kurngalfberg. Offer your services.

2057.title: Glaciont the Hardy
2057.description: Talk with Chieftain Akagitan. Talk with Delris. Find Glaciont the Hardy. Kill all the Ice Petrahulks. Glaciont the Hardy (1) Frostfist (1) Iceback (1) Chillblow (1) Snowfury (1) Talk with Chieftain Akagitan. Order: Red Mane Mau are being slaughtered by Ice Petrahulks. Meet Chieftain Akagitan.

2058.title: A Spy Among the Lepharists
2058.description: Meet with Tristran. Talk with Stua. Infiltrate the Port through the Secret Port Entrance. Don't blow your cover! Find the Alquimia Entrance, break through to the Daevic Genesis Lab, and destroy the Research Center Power Generator (1). Escape from the research center and send a Signal Flare signal to begin the attack. Report to Tristran. The Shadow Judges are investigating the Lepharist movement in Beluslan. Report to Tristran to help out.

2059.title: A Peace Offering
2059.description: Talk with Chieftain Akagitan. Talk with Hasyaditan. Talk with Arita. Escort Hoarfrost Survivors to where Kalitan is. Talk with Chieftain Akagitan. Report the result to Nerita. Escort Failed! Return to Molota. Order: The chieftain of the Red Mane tribe, Akagitan, wants someone to travel to the Hoarfrost Tribe. Report to Chieftain Akagitan.

2060.title: Restoring Beluslan Observatory
2060.description: Talk with Hod. Talk with Gwendolin. Talk with Hisui. Talk with Glati. Go to Leibo Island, gather Aether, and bring it to Gwendolin. PlayerDestroy Field Suppressors around the Observatory (3). Repair the Aetheric Field Maintaining Device. Report to Hod. Speak with Hod about repairing the damaged Observatory in Beluslan.

2061.title: Suppressing the Bakarma Legion
2061.description: Talk with Nerita. Talk with Votan. Talk with Nerita. Go to the Draupnir Cave and talk with Fafner. Destroy Balaur Aether-consuming Stones in the Lair of the Drake (8). Destroy the Aetheric Field Suppressing Device by killing Deputy Brigade General Yavant in Beritra's Oracle (1). Report to Nerita. Report to Vidar for your reward. Speak with Brigade General Nerita about ending the Bakarma Legion's invasion of Asmodae once and for all.

2071.title: Speaking Balaur
2071.description: Talk with Hisui. Talk to Sinjah. Weaken the Ashikar Assaulter and lure it out. Talk with Grunn. Talk with Kaoranerk. Speak with Phosphor. Bring the Language Crystal to Kaoranerk. Report the result to Hisui. Order: To carry out missions in the Abyss, you should learn the Balaur language. Meet Hisui and hear the details.

2072.title: Abyss Battle Training
2072.description: Talk with Leban. Learn about the fortress Aetheric Field from Vicht. Learn about the Fortress Gate and the Fortress Gate Restoration Stone from Mont. Learn about the Guardian General from Abend. Learn about Artifacts from Brysa. Learn about the Kisk from Eldorey. Learn about the Dredgions from Noiman. Speak to Spyr. Order: You have to receive basic education in how warfare works in the Abyss. Go to Leban and ask for training.

2073.title: Captured Comrades
2073.description: Talk with Jebal. Talk with Lakadi. Speak to Glati. Find Captured Asmodian Prisoner. Escort the Asmodian prisoners to the Magic Ward. Report the result to Lakadi. Order: Asmodian soldiers are imprisoned on the Isle of Disgrace in the Sulfur Archipelago. Brigade General Jebal has a mission to rescue them.

2074.title: Looking for Leibo
2074.description: Talk with Scoda. Go to Ishalgen and talk with Munin. Go to Pandaemonium and talk with Kasir. Talk with Lyeanenerk. Go to Reshanta and find Lugbug. Activate the Artifact of the Inception. Talk with Lugbug again. Check back in with Scoda. Order: Scoda, a Protector of Divinity, is looking for you secretly. Meet her at the Primum Fortress.

2075.title: Putting on the Speed
2075.description: Talk with Holm. Talk with Tierunerk. Find Gaochinerk in Tigraki Island. Go to Black Cloud Island and meet Garkbinerk. Report the result to Gaochinerk. Report the result to Holm. Holm has a favor to ask of you--an urgent matter. Go to the Primum Landing and meet him.

2076.title: The Shadow Summons
2076.description: Go to Brusthonin and meet Phyper. See if the prophecy of Phyper is realized. A summons has arrived! Go to Khrudgelmir. Talk with the Arena Master, Garm. Enter Underground Arena Entrance and find a Shadow Judge. Find Underground Arena Exit and escape from the Shadow Court Dungeon. Talk with Khrudgelmir. Go to Ishalgen and talk with Munin. Order: Phyper in Brusthonin has something to tell you. Go to Brusthonin and meet him.

2091.title: Meet the Reapers
2091.description: Meet Surt, the Captain of the Reaper Squad. Meet Surt, the Captain of the Reaper Squad in Brusthonin, and learn about the situation there.

2092.title: Graves of the Red Sky Legion
2092.description: Talk with Surt. Investigate the Dug-up Grave in The Legend Shrine. Talk with Theia, a ghost wandering near the tomb. Talk with Seznec. Take Remedy Ingredients to Seznec. PlayerCall the spirits of the Red Sky Legion members resting in The Legend Shrine, and talk with the ghosts. Get rid of Undead Grunts (15). Report the results of your investigation to Surt. Surt asked you to investigate the desecration of a tomb at the memorial to the Red Sky Legion. Report to Surt.

2093.title: The Secret Passage
2093.description: Talk with Surt. Talk with Neligor. Talk with BuBu Khaaan. Talk with BuBu Chan. Obtain BuBu Chan's Requested Items and bring them to BuBu Chan. PlayerTalk with Cayron. Find Book of Brohum. Talk with Cayron. Go to Old Nahor Castle and find the key to the secret passage in Old Wooden Box [%26]. Report back to Surt. Order: Surt needs you to find out what's going on at Adma Stronghold. Go to Surt and get the full story.

2094.title: The Secret of Adma Stronghold
2094.description: Talk with Surt. Talk with Sahnu. Get the Spirit Drop in Alukina's Palace and take it to Sahnu. PlayerTalk with Sahnu. Enter Adma Stronghold and get rid of Suspicious Person [%14]. Talk with Heintz. Knock Virkel's Tombstone and call the soul of Virkel. Inform Sigyn. Order: Surt asks you to find the passage to Adma Stronghold and see what still lies inside.

2096.title: Twice as Bright
2096.description: Go to Pandaemonium and talk with Cavalorn. Meet with Kasir in the Hidden Library. Go to Ishalgen and talk with Munin. Order: Arch Sage Cavalorn is looking for you. Go to the Temple of Knowledge in Pandaemonium to meet him.

2097.title: Spirit Blade
2097.description: Speak to Munin. Ask Skuld for the Spirit Blade designs. Get Spirit Blade Components and take them to Baoninerk. PlayerReturn to Munin. You need a Spirit Blade to control your dangerous inner powers. Ask Skuld about the Spirit Blade designs and have Baoninerk craft the sword.

2098.title: But What we Make
2098.description: Talk with Munin. Accept Hreidmar's divine blessing[%5]. Accept Bulagan's divine blessing[%8]. Accept Cayron's divine blessing[%11]. Accept Vanargand's divine blessing[%14]. Accept Esnu's divine blessing[%17]. Receive the Amulet of Insight from Skuld [%20]. Receive Ananta's incantation in the amulet [%23]. Receive Seznec's incantation in the amulet [%26]. Receive Kasir's incantation in the amulet [%29]. Listen to Aegir's advice[%32]. Listen to Heintz's advice[%35]. Listen to Delris's advice[%38]. Listen to Votan's advice[%41]. Listen to Kvasir's advice[%44]. Report the result to Munin [%48]. In order to change your future, you must purify yourself of evil power. Follow Munin's advice and obtain divine blessings from five holy creatures to make the Pearl of Purification.

2099.title: To Face the Future
2099.description: Talk with Munin. Locate the Fissure of Destiny leading to Ataxiar and talk with Hagen. Make your way to Ataxiar and annihilate the Guardian Legionarys (50). Vanquish Brigade General Hellion (1). Talk with Lephar. Report to Vidar. You are ready to vanquish Hellion and change your future. Find the Fissure of Destiny and go to Ataxiar.

2150.title: Brotherly Love
2150.description: Go to the Fast-Track Server and meet with Nowlan. Use "Menu," then "Go to Channel," and then "Go to Fast-Track Server," so that you can talk to Nowlan on behalf of Rian.

2151.title: Swallowing Pride
2151.description: Go back to the Standard Server and talk to Rian. Use "Menu," then "Go to Channel," and then "Go to Standard Server" to deliver Nowlan's reply to Rian.

2200.title: Altgard Duties
2200.description: Meet Suthran, commander of Altgard Fortress. Meet Brigade General Suthran and ask what needs doing in Altgard.

2300.title: Morheim Commander's Call
2300.description: Meet the Brigade General of Morheim, Aegir. Talk to the Brigade General of Morheim, Aegir, and receive missions.

2500.title: Orders From Nerita
2500.description: Meet the Brigade General of Beluslan, Nerita. Meet Nerita, the Brigade General of Beluslan, and receive your orders.

2549.title: A Gift For Amma
2549.description: Talk with Huarinrinerk. Ai might be interested in the marble... You found a Malek marble that might be valuable. Have Huarinrinerk appraise it.

2611.title: Consulting the Leaders
2611.description: Introduce yourself to Mostin. Speak with Delris. Get acquainted with Thor. Report back to Freyja. Visit Mostin, Delris, and Thor in the Red Mane Cavern, and assess the situation.

2929.title: Welcome to the Temple of Artisans
2929.description: Talk with Usener. Go to the Temple of Artisans and talk with Talon.

3732.title: [Group] General Mania
3732.description: Infiltrate the Nochsana Training Camp and use the siege weapon to destroy the Nochsana Fortress Gate. Defeat the Nochsana General [%5]. Report back to Brunto. Go to the Nochsana Training Camp, destroy the fortress gate, and defeat the Nochsana General.

4338.title: Necklace War
4338.description: Talk with Kellan. Gather Spiner Tails and take them to Kellan. PlayerListen to the story of Kellan. Meet Kimssi. Choose a MuMu to guide you. Throw Cursed Necklace into the Boiling Lava. Report back to Kellan. Order: There is an important mission regarding a Cursed Necklace. See Urakon who patrols the Fortress entrance.

4732.title: [Group] General Malevolence
4732.description: Infiltrate the Nochsana Training Camp and destroy the Nochsana Fortress Gate with the siege weapon. Defeat Nochsana General [%5]. Report back to Kelmar. Go to the Nochsana Training Camp, destroy the fortress gate, and defeat the Nochsana General.
