10070.title: Kaisinel's Command
10070.description: Talk to Kahrun. Go to Cloister of Kaisinel and talk with High Priest Eremitia. Deliver Kaisinel's Command to Kahrun. Talk with Ancanus. Go through the Portal to the Throne of Blood. Use the Blood-red Jewel to follow Kahrun. Listen to Tiamat's ravings. Talk to Kahrun. Talk with Lord Kaisinel. Report everything to Ancanus. Order: Lord Kaisinel commands you to help Kahrun kill Tiamat.

descriptionLinks.name: Portal to the Throne of Blood

10071.title: On the Trail of Israphel
10071.description: Talk to Kahrun. Talk to Killios. Ask Garnon to analyze the Magical Energy Signature. Use the Mysterious Orb to access Israphel's old hiding place. Get back to Garnon before this stone condition becomes permanent! Talk to Garnon. Report back to Killios. Order: Get on the trail of Lord Israphel, and find out where he took Siel's Relics.

10072.title: The Truth Revealed
10072.description: Talk with Killios. Harvest Rift Energy from Distorted Energy Nexuses, and bring it to Killios. PlayerLet Killios send you to Lord Israphel's hideout. Talk with Lord Israphel. Kahrun wants to speak to you urgently. Report everything to Killios. Order: Persuade Lord Israphel to return Siel's Relics.

10073.title: Shattered Alliance
10073.description: Talk with Eremitia. Sign the Confidentiality Covenant. PlayerTalk with Eremitia. Deliver the Sealed Letter to Kahrun. Talk with Garnon. Eliminate the Irksome Ringleaders. Haunting Kakaro (1) Danitur the Renegade (1) Reclusive Krata (1) Ancient Elder Ermus (1) Appease Kahrun. Report to Eremitia. Pernos called you for another chat. Order: Stop the dangerous truth from leaking out.

10100.title: Kahrun's Intrigue
10100.description: Talk with Atmis at Aequis Headquarters in Cygnea. See Teleporter Vernea at Aequis Headquarters in Cygnea to go to Levinshor. Talk with Tarena at Lumewillow Glade in Levinshor. Talk with Kahrun at Aetherbrak in Levinshor. Right-click on Kahrun's Drawing to examine it. Talk with Kahrun again. Order: Expedition Commander-in-chief Atmis is looking for you.

10101.title: Dismal Developments
10101.description: Talk with Kahrun at Aetherbrak in Levinshor. Use the Aetherbrak Invasion Corridor while the Aetheric Field Zone Tag is in your possession. Defeat the Linkgate Lookout at the Linkgate Foundry. (2) Open the Containment Barrier. Talk with Spy Ditono in Linkgate Foundry Secret Zone. Escape through the Secret Zone Invasion Corridor while the Secret Zone Tag is in your possession. Defeat Commander Gartacia in the Kaldor Invasion Zone. Take the Invasion Brief from the Commander and take it to Voltin. PlayerTalk with Voltin again. Talk with Alphioh at Saparinerk's Settlement in Kaldor. Order: Talk with Recovering Kahrun in Levinshor.

11150.title: Drana Farm Alarm
11150.description: Eliminate the Balaur in the Mephistis Farm. Basrasa Worker (10). Basrasa Draconute (10). Report the results to Iaetia. Help propel the Elyos advance in Inggison by wiping out the Balaur at Mephistis Farm.

11151.title: Silence the Murmurs and Hush the Snufflers
11151.description: Eliminate contaminated creatures in Mephistis Farm. Contaminated Murmur(4) Infused Snuffler(4) Report the outcome to Auralia. Carry out Auralia's request and eliminate contaminated creatures at Mephistis Farm that contribute to the spread of Drana.

11152.title: Get to the Root of it
11152.description: Take Dried White Roots to Auralia. PlayerObtain Wandering Root Dragrint's White Roots for Guardians who suffer from back pain.

11287.title: Inggison's Darkest Hour
11287.description: Use Enraged Veille's Aether Concentrator to give the Agent strength [%2]. Report to Yushin. Use the Aether Concentrator to give power to Kaisinel's Agent Veille while the agent is under attack from Asmodians.

11288.title: [Daily] Veille's Blessing
11288.description: Talk to Yushin. Agent Veille has instructed her assistant, Yushin, to reward all those who participated in the victory of Inggison.

11295.title: Hidden Quest to Play Cut Scenes

11305.title: [Alliance] Avarice for the Avarice
11305.description: Eliminate the Altar of Avarice Garrison. (10) Report the result to Ingnie. The Altar of Avarice has fallen to the enemy. Defeat the enemy garrison to weaken their defense.

11306.title: [League] Alter the Altar's Guardian
11306.description: Defeat the Guardian General and recapture the Altar of Avarice Altar of Avarice Guardian General (1) Report to Ingnie The Altar of Avarice must be recaptured from the enemy. Defeat the Guardian General there and report to Ingnie.

11307.title: [Alliance] A Crisis, a Crisis
11307.description: Eliminate the Temple of Scales Garrison. (10) Talk with Siaqua. The Temple of Scales is lost to the enemy. Eliminate some of their guards around the fortress.

11308.title: [League] Impatience is a Virtue
11308.description: Defeat the enemy's Guardian General and retrieve the Temple of Scales. Eliminate the Temple of Scales Guardian General. (1) Talk with Siaqua. The Temple of Scales is lost to the enemy. Destroy the Guardian General and reclaim the Fortress for the Elyos.

11319.title: Tour De Cygnea
11319.description: Travel to Cygnea and talk with Vernea. Travel to Cygnea with Naerty's assistance.

11323.title: ShuGo Go Go
11323.description: Talk with Gadarunerk. Talk with Izzyrunerk. Talk with Zeirunerk. Talk with Chubarunerk. Talk with Danirunerk. Speak to Yulia. Daevas are gathering in Inggison. Meet Brigade General Yulia of the Hushblade Legion and find out what is happening.

11324.title: [Daily/Spy] No Mo' Asmos
11324.description: Infiltrate Gelkmaros and eliminate the Asmodians. (2) Report to Versetti. Infiltrate Gelkmaros to eliminate the Asmodians and report back to Versetti.

11325.title: [Daily] Get 'em out of Inggison
11325.description: Eliminate the Asmodians who infiltrated Inggison. (2) Report to Versetti. Eliminate the Asmodians who infiltrated Inggison, and report to Versetti.

13403.title: Portal Predictions
13403.description: Talk with Centurion William. Go to Reported Invasion Site in Verteron Swamp and use an Infiltration Sensor to investigate the area. [%5] Since nothing happened, talk to Beris in Tolbas Village. Go to Beris' Remembered Invasion Site in the Southern Tolbas Forest and use the Infiltration Detector to investigate. [%11] Since nothing happened, talk to Guardian Legionary Jenel in Verteron Observatory. Investigate the Damaged Invasion Generator on the Cantas Coast and obtain the Preserved Circuit. Investigate the Inoperable Invasion Generator on the Cantas Coast and obtain the Intact Circuit. Deliver the memory cores to Centurion Alisdair in Verteron Citadel. Talk with Spatalos in Verteron. It's urgent.

13900.title: [Hero] When Kaisinel Calls
13900.description: Go to Inggison Illusion Fortress and talk with Outremus. Talk with Teleporter Polyidus in Sanctum. Talk with Adrass. Go to Outremus at the Inggison Illusion Fortress to carry out new duties.

13901.title: [Hero/Group] A Test of Courage
13901.description: Gather the Courage Insignia Bundle and take them to Adrass. PlayerGather Courage Insignias from the Infernal Danuar Reliquary and the Infernal Illuminary Obelisk.

13902.title: [Hero] Bracing for Balaurea
13902.description: Talk with Outremus in the Inggison Illusion Fortress. Find Outremus in the Inggison Illusion Fortress to aide the Balaurea conquest.

13903.title: [Hero] Beyond the Basics
13903.description: Complete the Levinshor Occupation Report and the Conqueror's Orb, and take them to Outremus. PlayerComplete the Levinshor Occupation Report and the Conqueror's Orb.

13904.title: [Hero/Daily] Ace of Bases
13904.description: Complete the Levinshor Occupation Report and the Conqueror's Orb, and then take them to Outremus. PlayerComplete the Levinshor Occupation Report and the Conqueror's Orb.

13905.title: [Hero/Daily] Sweeping the North
13905.description: Defeat the enemy Warcaptains and Subjugators occupying the bases. North Picket Commander (1) North Outpost Commander (1) North Relay Commander (1) Talk with Eljer. Defeat the enemy Warcaptains and Subjugators occupying the bases in northern Levinshor.

13906.title: [Hero/Daily] Bringing Peace to the East
13906.description: Defeat the enemy Commanders occupying the bases. East Relay Commander (1) East Outpost Commander (1) East Picket Commander (1) Talk with Eljer. Defeat the enemy Warcaptains and Subjugators occupying the bases in eastern Levinshor.

13907.title: [Hero/Daily] Striking the Southern Hold
13907.description: Defeat the enemy Commanders occupying the bases. South Picket Commander (1) South Outpost Commander (1) South Relay Commander (1) Talk with Eljer. Defeat the enemy Warcaptains and Subjugators occupying the bases in southern Levinshor.

13908.title: [Hero/Daily] Not so Quiet on the Western Front
13908.description: Defeat the enemy Commanders occupying the bases. West Relay Commander (1) West Outpost Commander (1) West Picket Commander (1) Talk with Eljer. Defeat the enemy Warcaptains and Subjugators occupying the bases in western Levinshor.

13909.title: [Hero/Group] Kill Their Idols
13909.description: Defeat the Tomuls around the base and investigate the Vocoliths using their Ancestor's Relic, and then slay the hideous creatures that are summoned. Lava Arm Cruego (1) Cruel Lamia (1) Destroyer Feld (1) Ruthless Tyrannica (1) Talk with Eljer. Investigate the Vocolith that the Tomul hold sacred and slay the hideous ancient monsters summoned there.

13910.title: [Hero/Alliance] Conquering Kaldor
13910.description: Defeat the enemy occupying the Kaldor Fortress and artifacts to conquer Kaldor. Wealhtheow's Keep Guardian General (1) Hero's Fall Artifact Protector (1) Ashen Glade Artifact Protectors (1) Molten Cliffs Artifact Protector (1) Berserk Anoha, summoned by the Legion Brigade General who captured the fortress. (1) Talk with Adrass. Vanquish the artifact protectors and the Fortress Guardian General in Kaldor, and then defeat the Berserk Anoha summoned by the Legion's Brigade General who captured the fortress.

13914.title: [Hero/Alliance] Full Throttle
13914.description: Complete the Grand Invasion Orb and take it to Perna. PlayerThwart the invasion of the Beritra Army and complete the Grand Invasion Orb as proof.

13915.title: [Hero/Weekly/Alliance] Take 2
13915.description: Complete the Grand Invasion Orb and take it to Perna. PlayerThwart the invasion of Beritra's Army and complete the Orb of Grand Invasion one more time.

13916.title: [Hero/Alliance] A Shadow over Levinshor
13916.description: Defeat Empowered Mastarius to obtain the Agent's Fragmented Brooch and take it to Eljer. PlayerDefeat Empowered Mastarius, who appears in the Flameberth Downs in Levinshor, and return with proof.

13917.title: [Hero/Group] Snuffing out a Flame
13917.description: Eliminate the Shrine Force Subjugator or Shrine Defense Commander in the Dragon Lord's Shrine. (1) Talk with Povit, who appears when the base is captured. Eliminate the enemies in the Dragon Lord's Shrine to capture the base and then talk with Povit.

13918.title: [Hero/Group] Live by the Sword...
13918.description: Eliminate the Drakan Elite Raider who is after the commanders. (1) Eliminate the Drakan Elite Bladesman who is after the commanders. (1) Eliminate the Drakan Elite Ambusher who is after the commanders. (1) Eliminate the Archon Elite Raider who is after the commanders. (1) Eliminate the Archon Elite Bladesman who is after the commanders. (1) Talk with Eljer. Eliminate the enemy elites who are after the Elyos commanders.

14080.title: Teetering in Tiamaranta
14080.description: Go to Hushblade Headquarters in Tiamaranta and talk to Ancanus. Go and talk to the Reian Scholar Pashilion. Go to the Avad Village and defeat Avad Dragonbound to get Tiamaranta's Clue. Then ask for Flavia's advice. PlayerGo to Petro Outpost and talk to Flavia. Search Siel's Temple Ruins and defeat Sheban Legion Quartermaster (1). Go to Petro Outpost and talk to Flavia again. Go to Hushblade Headquarters and report to Ancanus. Order: Meet Tiamaranta Hushblade Commander Ancanus.

14081.title: The Heart of the Present
14081.description: Go to Garnon's Secret Chamber in Tiamaranta and talk to Protector Oriata. Use the Detector Core in Magic Ward to summon Heart Detector and reveal the power of the Hearts. Defeat the Source Protector that still remain near the Heart of Gravity (1). After defeating the Fragment of Wrath near the Heart of Wrath, reveal the power of the Hearts that is maintained in Exploding Rock. Lift the remaining curtain in Petrified Core to reveal the power of the Hearts. Go to Garnon's Secret Chamber in Tiamaranta and talk to Protector Oriata. Order: Talk to Protector Oriata in Garnon's Secret Chamber in Tiamaranta.

14090.title: Traces of the Past
14090.description: Go to Garnon's Secret Chamber in Tiamaranta and talk to Protector Oriata of the Present. Activate the Riftsands near Protector Oriata of the Present to get to the past. Investigate Tiamat's Body. Talk to Oriata of the Past at the Throne of Blood. Talk to Israphel of the past at the Extradimensional Void. Investigate Concentrated Ide Crystal. Talk to Oriata of the Past at the Extradimensional Void. Order: Meet with Tiamaranta's Protector Oriata to learn the truth.

14091.title: Identity Business
14091.description: Talk to Oriata of the Past at the Extradimensional Void. Talk to Kaisinel, lord of the past, at the Extradimensional Void. Talk to Agent Outremus of the past. To prove who you are in the past, go to Cloister of Kaisinel and talk to Eremitia. To prove yourself, talk to Fasimedes. Go to Cloister of Kaisinel and talk to Eremitia once more. Talk to Garnon. Report to Crispin. Order: Talk to Oriata of the Past at the Extradimensional Void.

14110.title: Suspicious Symbols
14110.description: Gather the Revolutionary Symbols and take them to Spiros in Verteron Citadel. PlayerConfirm the identity of the suspicious people snooping around the fortress.

14111.title: Prey for the Lepharists
14111.description: Eliminate the Lepharist Revolutionaries on Belbua's Farm. Thief (9) Cavil (1) Talk with Abolos in Tolbas Village. Help Abolos wipe out the Lepharist Revolutionaries around Belbua's Farm.

14112.title: Pollution Resolution
14112.description: Talk with Lepios in Frillneck Woods. Defeat Poisonous Bubblegut. (1) Talk with Kato. Eliminate the source of contamination at the Contaminated Swamp to stop it from spreading.

14113.title: Steal Back the Sacred
14113.description: Recover the Icon of Kaisinel from five of the Tursin Holy Ground Guards or Captured Tursin Guards in Haramel and take them to Lunax in Ardus Shrine. PlayerDefeat and recover the sacred images from the Krall who stole them from the temple and are now wandering around the Holy Ground.

14114.title: Revolution Intervention
14114.description: Go to Verteron Observatory and talk with Khidia. Investigate the inside of the Mysterious Shipwreck. Scouting complete! Talk with Khidia. Go to the Mysterious Shipwreck, kill Captain Kinsgreen, search his body for clues, and return to Khidia. PlayerGo back to Verteron Citadel and talk with Spatalos. Investigate the Lepharist Revolutionaries on the Cantas Coast.

14120.title: The Bucket List
14120.description: Talk with Demro in the Manduri Forest. Obtain a bucket from Kerubian Bucket in Putrid Mire and take it to Lodas in the Eiron Desert. PlayerTalk with the Elim who seeks help with the desertification of Eltnen.

14121.title: Splitting Stones
14121.description: Talk with Lakaias in the Novan's Crossing. Eradicate the Ancient Caryatids to obtain the evidence and take it to Lakaias at the Novan's Crossing. PlayerGo to the Outpost Ruins and find out what has happened to the artifact.

14122.title: Oasis Wasted
14122.description: Talk with Ophelos at the Mystic Spring of Laquepin. Talk with Heratos at the Western Eracus Desert. Talk with Sirink near Kyola Temple. The Mystic Springs that Empyrean Lord Yustiel created are drying out. Go and find out about the Mystic Springs in Eltnen.

14123.title: The Shadow of Vengeance
14123.description: Talk with Dionera at the Eltnen Observatory. Kill Peddler Hippolytus in the empty lot behind the Aetheric Field Observatory. (1) Report back to Dionera at the Eltnen Observatory. Find and kill Peddler Philipemos, who destroyed the Mystic Spring and is plotting something at the Aetheric Field Observatory.

14124.title: Murky Waters
14124.description: Get rid of the Lehpar Revolutionaries. Scout Vaegir (3). Scout Fighter (3). Report back to Asclepius in Agairon Village. Bring to justice the Lepharist Revolutionaries who contaminated the water source.

14150.title: Secrets of the Superus
14150.description: Talk to Ibelia at the Destroyed Guard Tower. Find the Vaizel's Peak Engraving at Vaizel's Peak and take it to Sarantus. PlayerSarantus asked you to assist Ibelia, a Daeva of Zephyr.

14151.title: Target Practice with a Queen
14151.description: Destroy Klawspawn to lure out and kill Queen Taklaw (1). Report back to Barzon at the New Heiron Gate. Klaws are threatening the ecological system of the Poya Jungle. Senea knows the answer.

14152.title: Spoiler Alert
14152.description: Meet with Finn in the Research Center Overwatch. Take the Lepharist Poison Sample to Jumentis at the Protectors Hall in Sanctum. Get rid of Chairman Garnis at the Lepharist Research Center (1). Talk with Sofne at the New Heiron Gate. As Sofne requested, meet with Finn to carry out a mission related to the Lephar Revolutionaries and a mysterious chairman.

14153.title: A Storm of Vengeance
14153.description: Talk with Sulates. Talk with Anto in Jeiaparan Village. Destroy Cursed Obelisk (1). Talk with Anto in Jeiaparan Village. Talk with Maximus. Burn incense at Patema Geyser for Myanee. Report the result to Sulates. Sulates has a favor to ask you. Go and see him.

14200.title: Eternal Flames
14200.description: Go to Josnack's Vigil and speak to Josnack. Destroy the Eternal Flame. (3) Report back to Atropos in Observatory Village. Destroy the Eternal Flame.

14201.title: Weapons of Past Destruction
14201.description: Go to the Hongras Campsite and speak with Hongras. Talk with Serimnir in Marla Cave. Defeat Chieftain Dadum to obtain the Calydon Scroll and take it back to Atropos in Observatory Village. PlayerAtropos asked you to speak with Hongras about the secret weapons laboratory that was once in Theobomos.

14202.title: Two Hands are Better than None
14202.description: Go to Theobomos and talk to Atropos. General Perento asked you to help Atropos, Protector of the Aetheric Field Observatory in Theobomos.

14240.title: Desert's Encroachment
14240.description: Extinguish the Blaze Spirits and Flame Spirits. (9) Report back to Radamanthys. Extinguish the Blaze Spirits and Flame Spirits around Sataloca's Tomb as Radamanthys requested.

14241.title: A Triumph's a Triumph
14241.description: Deliver Kimeia's message to Diomedes. Deliver Kimeia's message to Diomedes.

14242.title: Kralls Bugging Kralls
14242.description: Eliminate the Crack Kaidan Grapplers. (9) Report back to Captured Gardugu. Gardugu said that Crack Kaidan Grapplers are the core of the growing forces at Kaidan Mine. Get rid of them.

14243.title: Golden Son, Gone
14243.description: Meet Hannet. Meet Hannet as Castor asked.

14244.title: Eltnen Job
14244.description: Talk with Brunto. Lodas said Brunto has been looking for you. Find him at the Eltnen Fortress.

14250.title: Start with the Strongest
14250.description: Eliminate the Indratu Serpentguards. (10) Talk with Javlantia. Eliminate the Indratu Serpentguards.

14251.title: Because Caves are Easy
14251.description: Head over to the Dragon's Blood Canyon and meet Anaxa. A Balaur base has been discovered. Go see Anaxa.

14260.title: The Dark Transcendence
14260.description: Talk with Maloren. Danais said Priestess Maloren in Heiron is urgently looking for you. Speak with Maloren.

14261.title: Darkness Unpassed
14261.description: Meet with Maloren. Atropos said Priestess Maloren in Heiron is looking for you. Speak with Maloren.

14270.title: [Group] A Bio Weapon Bio
14270.description: Talk with Anaxa in Dragon's Blood Canyon. Talk with Anaxa, who has been dispatched to Draupnir Cave, to obtain the Bio Weapon Sample.

14271.title: [Group] Research Party
14271.description: Talk with Pyrrha at the Anangke Excavation Camp. Visit Pyrrha at the Anangke Excavation Camp and assist her.

14275.title: [Group] Mother and Son Asunder
14275.description: Talk with Hannet at the Kyola Temple Entrance. Meet Hannet at the Kyola Temple.

14276.title: [Group] Impede Kromede
14276.description: Get rid of Kromede's servants in the Fire Temple. Lurker Gargoyle (5) Aetheric Mugolem (3) Kalgolem of Magic (2) Talk with Hannet at the Kyola Temple Entrance. Get rid of Kromede's loyal servants that protect the Fire Temple.

15000.title: Not Any Fool's Tool
15000.description: Recover the Lost Backpack and take it to Millard. PlayerTalk with Millard. Use the Artificial Aether Generator Repair Tool near the Artificial Aether Generator in the sky above Aequis Headquarters. Talk with Millard. Help Artificial Aether Generator Supervisor Millard solve her problem.

15042.title: Calling Kaisinel's Butterfly
15042.description: Use the Moon-welcome Flute at the Dragon Lord's Gardens to find Kaisinel's Butterfly. (3) Talk with Telos. Use the flute at Dragon Lord's Gardens to search for any sign of the Empyrean Lord.

15098.title: What the ship?
15098.description: Talk with Gremas. Learn about the current situation from Teleporter Gremas.

15101.title: Time For Your Close Up
15101.description: Look for Nostibas in the Wailing Dunes. Kill Sand Mane Seagrics in the Wailing Dunes. (10) Talk with Nostibas. Talk to Nostibas in the Wailing Dunes about joining the Aequis Blade Detachment.

16942.title: Foundry Finds
16942.description: Use the Linkgate Foundry Corridor to enter Linkgate Foundry and talk with Ketesivius. Obtain the Dimension Research Journal and Monster's Blood and take them to Eljer. PlayerObtain the Dimension Research Journal and Monster's Blood from Linkgate Foundry and take them to Tribunus Eljer.

16974.title: Monster Abridged
16974.description: Eliminate Brigade General Velkur at Ophidan Bridge. (1) Talk with Theana. Eliminate Brigade General Velkur and go see Theana.

16975.title: Fugative Fragment
16975.description: Take the fragment you obtained from a fugitive to Theana. Take the fragment you obtained from a fugitive to Theana.

16976.title: Velkur's Valuable Piece
16976.description: Talk with Theana. Obtain the Velkur's Relic and take it to Timarchus. PlayerObtain the Piece Carried by Velkur at Ophidan Bridge and take it to Timarchus.

18037.title: [Alliance] Keep Up the Defense
18037.description: Defeat Grand Commander Pashid. (1) Talk to Demades. Defeat Grand Commander Pashid at the Eternal Bastion.

18412.title: Hidden Quest to Play Cut Scenes (Elyos)

18917.title: Don't Wait, Infiltrate
18917.description: Go to Levinshor and then talk with Eljer. Talk with Kanix at the Aetherbrak. Meet with Eljer in Levinshor.

19049.title: [Craft] Clamping Down
19049.description: Craft Iron Clamps, and take them to Undin. PlayerUndin has asked you to craft Iron Clamps for Construction and show them to him to prove your worth.

19051.title: Daevas of the Round Table
19051.description: Go to Reshanta and deliver the Round Table to Lucius. Undin has crafted a Round Table. Deliver it to the Weapon Merchant Lucius at the Teminon Landing in Reshanta.

19059.title: Its Rightful Owner
19059.description: Take the Guardsman's Side Table to Cymaon. The Guardsman's Side Table has a delivery tag for Cymaon in Reshanta. Take it to him.

19078.title: Master Aethertech
19078.description: Use Power Flux I (10). Report the results to Oakley. Complete the task given to you and report back to Oakley.

19643.title: Outrageous Outremus
19643.description: Talk with Outremus at Inggison Illusion Fortress. Go to the Inggison Illusion Fortress to meet Agent Outremus.

19644.title: To the Land of the Unknown
19644.description: Talk with Atmis in Cygnea. Go to Cygnea and meet with Atmis.

19645.title: [Daily] Eliminating the Hindrance in the Supply Route
19645.description: Go to Cygnea and remove Large Clamshell Oculis or Lurking Clamshell Oculis. (10) Talk with Atmis at the Aequis Headquarters. Eliminate Oculis and report to Atmis.

19646.title: What Beritra is After
19646.description: Talk with Eukraton at the Aequis Advance Post. Go to Cygnea and meet with Eukraton.

19647.title: [Daily] Eukraton in Need
19647.description: Go to Cygnea and kill Ebontongue Hornskulls or Proximus Ametgolems. (10) Talk with Eukraton at the Aequis Advance Post. Kill monsters and report to Eukraton.

19648.title: Cooperation Request for Elimination of Beritra
19648.description: Talk with Brunte at the Aequis Outpost. Talk with Brunte.

20070.title: Marchutan's Will
20070.description: Talk to Kahrun. Go to Convent of Marchutan and talk with High Priest Agehia. Deliver Marchutan's Command to Kahrun. Talk with Skafir. Go through the Portal to the Throne of Blood. Use the Blood-red Jewel to follow Kahrun. Listen to Tiamat's ravings. Talk to Throne of Blood. Talk with Lord Marchutan. Report everything to Skafir. Order: Lord Marchutan commands you to help Kahrun kill Tiamat.

descriptionLinks.name: Portal to the Throne of Blood

20071.title: The Hunt for Israphel
20071.description: Talk to Kahrun. Talk with Aimah. Ask Garnon to analyze the Magical Energy Signature. Use the Mysterious Orb to access Israphel's old hiding place. Get back to Garnon before this stone condition becomes permanent! Talk to Garnon. Report back to Aimah. Order: Get on the trail of Lord Israphel, and find out where he took Siel's Relics.

20072.title: Israphel's True Face
20072.description: Talk with Aimah. Harvest Rift Energy from Distorted Energy Nexuses, and bring it to Aimah. PlayerLet Killios send you to Lord Israphel's hideout. Talk with Lord Israphel. Kahrun wants to speak to you urgently. Report everything to Aimah. Order: Persuade lord Israphel to return Siel's Relics.

20073.title: Alliances Undone
20073.description: Talk with Agehia. Sign the Confidentiality Covenant. Player.Talk with Agehia. Deliver the Sealed Letter to Kahrun. Talk with Garnon. Eliminate the Irksome Ringleaders. Haunting Kakaro (1). Danitur the Renegade (1). Reclusive Krata (1). Ancient Elder Ermus (1). Appease Kahrun. Report to Agehia. You hear Munin calling. Go and see him. Order: Stop the dangerous truth from leaking out.

20100.title: Ghost of a Bygone Age
20100.description: Talk with Haldor at Dragonrest Temple in Enshar. See Teleporter Migrak at Dragonrest Temple in Enshar to go to Levinshor. Talk with Girtan at Pinnacle Cataracts in Levinshor. Talk with Kahrun at Stonepike Falls in Levinshor. Examine Kahrun's Illustration received from Kahrun. Talk with Kahrun again. Order: Expedition Governor Haldor is looking for you.

20101.title: Unraveling the Mystery
20101.description: Talk with Kahrun at Stonepike Falls in Levinshor. Use the Stonepike Invasion Corridor while a Fountainhead Zone Tag is in your possession. Defeat the Linkgate Lookouts at the Linkgate Foundry. (2) Open the Containment Barrier and investigate the area. Talk with Spy Ditono in the Linkgate Foundry Secret Zone. Escape through the Secret Zone Invasion Corridor while a Secret Zone Tag is in your possession. Defeat Commander Virca in the Kaldor Invasion Zone, obtain an Invasion Brief, and take it to Kisian. PlayerTalk with Kisian again. Talk with Feroz at Rubirinerk's Settlement in Kaldor. Order: Talk with Kahrun.

21289.title: Aid to the Agent
21289.description: Use Enraged Mastarius's Aether Concentrator to give the Agent strength [%2]. Talk to Mijien. Use Mastarius's Aether Concentrator to lend power to Mastarius while he is under attack by the Elyos.

21290.title: [Daily] Mastarius's Blessing
21290.description: Talk with Mijien. Visit Agent Mastarius's Shadow Mijien for your reward commemorating the successful defense of Gelkmaros Defense Base.

21291.title: Mastarius's Gift
21291.description: Take Mastarius's letter to Athana. Give Athana the letter to receive your reward.

21303.title: [Spy/League] A Destined Weapon
21303.description: Infiltrate the Elyos Fortress and terminate the Guardian General. Hunt the Guardian General of Temple of Scales (1). Hunt the Guardian General of Altar of Avarice (1). Report the results to Athana. Terminate the Guardian Generals who guard the Temple of Scales and the Altar of Avarice, then return to Athana.

21304.title: Money, Materials, and Genius
21304.description: Take Athana's Cipher-Blade, the materials, and 8 million Kinah to Usener. PlayerAthana said Usener will enhance the power of your keyblade if you take the keyblade, the materials, and the 8 million Kinah to her. Go see Usener.

21305.title: Clear out the Tiamat Remnants
21305.description: Vanquish Isbariya the Resolute. (1) Report the result to Richelle. Go to the Pashumandir Temple and vanquish Isbariya the Resolute.

21306.title: [Alliance] Take Back the Citadel
21306.description: Defeat the Vorgaltem Citadel Garrison (10). Talk with Krizarid. Vorgaltem Citadel has fallen to the Elyos. Take down the Elyos defenses by defeating the Citadel Garrison and then report to Krizarid.

21307.title: [League] Guardian of Vorgaltem
21307.description: Vanquish the enemy Guardian General to reclaim the Vorgaltem Citadel. Vorgaltem Citadel Guardian General (1) Talk with Krizarid. The Vorgaltem Citadel must be recaptured. Vanquish the Guardian General and report to Krizarid.

21308.title: [Alliance] The Asmodian Empire Stikes Back
21308.description: Eliminate the Crimson Temple Garrison. (10) Talk with Cozett. The Crimson Temple has fallen to the enemy. When the temple is vulnerable, eliminate the enemy garrison.

21309.title: [League] The Crimson Tide of War
21309.description: Defeat the enemy Guardian General to retake the Crimson Temple. Crimson Temple Guardian General (1) Talk with Cozett. The Crimson Temple has fallen to the enemy. Defeat the Guardian General to retake the temple.

21320.title: Excited for Enshar
21320.description: Talk with Migrak. Go to Enshar and see Teleporter Migrak.

21323.title: The Shugo Runaround
21323.description: Talk to Taserunerk. Talk to Potarunerk. Talk to Usrunerk. Talk to Ruinrunerk. Talk to Zinarunerk. Talk to Valetta. Daevas are gathering in Gelkmaros. Meet General Valetta of the Fatebound Legion to obtain more information.

21324.title: [Daily/Spy] No Elyos in Gelkmaros
21324.description: Infiltrate Inggison and eliminate the Elyos. (2) Report to Valetta. Infiltrate Inggison, eliminate the Elyos, and report back to Valetta.

21325.title: [Daily] Erase the Elyos
21325.description: Eliminate the Elyos who have infiltrated Gelkmaros. (2) Report to Valetta. Eliminate the Elyos who have infiltrated Gelkmaros and report to Valetta.

23403.title: Weapons Here, Weapons There
23403.description: Talk to Meiyer. Go to the Reported Invasion Site in Altgard Ice Lake and use an Invasion Sensor to investigate the area. [%5] Nothing happened! Talk to Kueve in Basfelt Village. Go to the Remembered Invasion Site in Idun's Lake and use the Invasion Detector to investigate. [%11] Nothing happened! Talk to Watchman Shezen in front of the Haramel Secret Passage. Investigate the Ruined Invasion Generator in Impetusium and obtain the Maintained Circuit. Investigate the Malfunctioning Invasion Generator in Impetusium and obtain the Undamaged Circuit. Report back to Morn in Altgard Fortress. Something urgent is afoot. Talk with Suthran in Altgard.

23900.title: [Hero] Fate of the Fierce
23900.description: Talk with Agent Richelle in Gelkmaros Fortress. Talk with Heimdall in Pandaemonium. Talk with Halia. Go meet the Empyrean Lord's Agent to carry out new duties.

23901.title: [Hero/Group] A Test of Valiance
23901.description: Gather the Valiant Mark Bundle and take them to Halia. PlayerGather the Valiant Marks from the Infernal Danuar Reliquary and the Infernal Illuminary Obelisk.

23902.title: [Hero] Prepare to Prevail
23902.description: Talk with Agent Richelle in Gelkmaros Fortress. Find Agent Richelle in Gelkmaros Fortress to learn about your upcoming place in the Balaurea missions.

23903.title: [Hero] Prove Your Supremacy
23903.description: Take the Levinshor Holding Report and the Supremacy Bead to Richelle. PlayerAttempt to obtain the Levinshor Holding Report and the Supremacy Bead.

23904.title: [Hero/Daily] Cover Your Bases
23904.description: Take the Levinshor Holding Report and the Supremacy Bead to Richelle. PlayerTry to obtain the Levinshor Holding Report and the Supremacy Bead once more.

23905.title: [Hero/Daily] Northern Occupation
23905.description: Defeat the enemy Commanders occupying the bases. North Picket Commander (1) North Outpost Commander (1) North Relay Commander (1) Talk with Yasan. Defeat the enemy Commanders occupying the bases in northern Levinshor.

23906.title: [Hero/Daily] Defeat the East
23906.description: Defeat the enemy Commanders occupying the bases. East Relay Commander (1) East Outpost Commander (1) East Picket Commander (1) Report to Yasan. Defeat the enemy Commanders occupying the bases in eastern Levinshor.

23907.title: [Hero/Daily] Southern Knockout
23907.description: Defeat the Commanders occupying the bases. South Picket Commander (1) South Outpost Commander (1) South Relay Commander (1) Talk with Yasan. Defeat the enemy Commanders occupying the bases in southern Levinshor.

23908.title: [Hero/Daily] Go West, Young Daeva
23908.description: Defeat the enemy Commanders occupying the bases. West Relay Commander (1) West Outpost Commander(1) West Picket Commander (1) Talk with Yasan. Defeat the enemy Commanders occupying the bases in western Levinshor.

23909.title: [Hero/Group] Something Wicked
23909.description: Defeat the Denkus around the base and investigate the Vocoliths using the Ancestor's Relics seized from them. Then slay the ancient monsters that are summoned. Lava Arm Cruego (1) Cruel Lamia (1) Destroyer Feld (1) Ruthless Tyrannica (1) Talk with Yasan. Investigate the Ancient Summoning Stones held sacred by the Denkus and slay the hideous ancient monsters.

23910.title: [Hero/Alliance] Seizing the Moment
23910.description: Defeat the enemy occupying the Wealhtheow's Keep and Artifacts to conquer Kaldor. Wealhtheow's Keep Guardian General (1) Hero's Fall Artifact Protector (1) Ashen Glade Artifact Protector (1) Molten Cliffs Artifact Protector (1) Berserk Anoha, summoned by the Legion Brigade General who captured the fortress. (1) Talk with Halia. Vanquish the Artifact Protectors and the Fortress Guardian General in Kaldor, and then defeat the Berserk Anoha summoned by the Legion's Brigade General who captured the Keep.

23914.title: [Hero/Alliance] Stemming the Tide
23914.description: Complete the Grand Invasion Bead and take it to Eldran. PlayerRepel the invasion of the Beritra Army and complete the Orb.

23915.title: [Hero/Weekly/Alliance] I'm not Quite Stemmed Yet
23915.description: Complete the Grand Invasion Bead and take it to Eldran. PlayerHelp stall the Beritra Army once again by bringing back another Orb to Eldran.

23916.title: [Hero/Alliance] Un-Veille the Agents
23916.description: Defeat Empowered Veille to obtain the Agent's Brooch Piece and take it to Yasan. PlayerDefeat the Elyos Agent, Empowered Veille, who has appeared in the Flameberth Downs in Levinshor and return with a Brooch Piece as proof.

23917.title: [Hero/Group] Knockout, Watchout
23917.description: Eliminate the Shrine Force Subjugator or Shrine Garrison Commander at the Dragon Lord's Shrine. (1) Talk with Zele, who appears when the base is captured. Eliminate the enemy's Commander at the Dragon Lord's Shrine and capture the base, then talk with Ziln when he appears.

23918.title: [Hero/Group] Can't Stop, Won't Stop
23918.description: Eliminate the Drakan Elite Raider, who is after the Commanders. (1) Eliminate the Drakan Elite Bladesman, who is after the Commanders. (1) Eliminate the Drakan Elite Ambusher, who is after the Commanders. (1) Eliminate the Guardian Elite Raider, who is after the Commanders. (1) Eliminate the Guardian Elite Bladesman, who is after the Commanders. (1) Talk with Yasan. Eliminate the Elite Raiders, who are after the Asmodian base Commanders.

24080.title: Conspiracy in Tiamaranta
24080.description: Talk with Skafir. Talk with a Reian scholar called Pashilion. Wipe out the Avad Dragonbound and take the Idgel Purification Device Component you obtained to Hindla. PlayerScout the Siel Temple Ruins and eliminate Sheban Legion Quartermaster. (1) Talk with Hindla. Report to Skafir. Order: Meet with Tiamaranta Commander Skafir.

24081.title: Secrets Within the Heart
24081.description: Talk with Protector Oriata who has appeared at Garnon's Secret Chamber in Rancora Fortress. Use the Ide Monitoring Device at Magic Ward to summon a Heart Detector and confirm that the Source of Power is being maintained. Acquire the Fragment of Gravity after generating Gap of Time and Space by defeating Fragmented Gapemaw at Gravity Well. Vanquish Heart of Fissure Guardian near the Heart of Fissure and confirm that the heart of power is being maintained. [%11] Scout Petrified Core and confirm that the heart of power is being maintained. Talk with Protector Oriata in Garnon's Secret Chamber. Order: Talk with Protector Oriata, who has appeared at Rancora Fortress.

24090.title: Footsteps of the Past
24090.description: Find Protector Oriata in Garnon's Secret Chamber. Use the Riftsands near Protector Oriata. Examine Tiamat's Body. Talk with Oriata of the Past at the Throne of Blood. Talk with Empyrean Lord Israphel at the Extradimensional Void. Examine the Concentrated Ide Crystal. Talk with Oriata of the Past at the Extradimensional Void. Order: Go to Protector Oriata in Rancora Fortress and face the truth.

24091.title: Unending Mission
24091.description: Talk with Oriata of the Past at the Extradimensional Void. Talk with Empyrean Lord Marchutan at the Extradimensional Void. Talk with Aimah in Sarpan. Talk with Agehia in Convent of Marchutan. Talk with Governor Vidar. Talk with Agehia in Convent of Marchutan. Talk with Garnon in Sarpan. Report your arrival in Kamar to Tepes. Order: Talk with Oriata of the past at the Extradimensional Void.

24110.title: Control Altgard, Delete Revolutions
24110.description: Kill The Lepharist Revolutionaries occupying Altgard Ice Lake (4). Talk with Meiyer in Altgard Fortress. Defeat Lepharist Revolutionaries in Altgard Ice Lake.

24111.title: What's Up, Dock?
24111.description: Find the Lepharist Primer in the house at Manir's Dock and take it to Nokir in Basfelt Village. PlayerFind what the Lepharist Revolutionaries near Manir's Dock are looking for.

24113.title: Sword to Secrecy
24113.description: Seize [STR_DIC_I_QUEST_24113A] from Sentinel Leader Gattban and take it to Aurtri in the Altgard Observatory. PlayerEliminate the Lepharists who threaten the Aetheric Field Observatory.

24114.title: You Gotta Stop Umkata
24114.description: Get rid of Hero Spirits. (3). Return to Gulkalla. Take Umkata's Three Tokens to Umkata's Grave to wake and destroy his spirit. PlayerReport back to Gulkalla. Meet Gulkalla and help him reconstruct Impetusium.

24115.title: A Shugo Apropos
24115.description: Kill Crimsontail Ampha (3). Deliver the materials to Banatisai in the Heart of Impetusium. Meet Neparinerk and help him get new tools to Impetusium.

24120.title: Sticks and Stones
24120.description: Talk with Nabaru in the Patamor Thicket. Talk with Belemu's Advocate at the Hill of Belemu. Talk with Nabaru in the Patamor Thicket. Revive an Elim Elder who is turning into stone.

24121.title: [Group] Secrets of the Fire Temple
24121.description: Talk with Bulagan in the Sky Temple of Arkanis. Talk with Flamyar at the Fire Temple Entrance. Defeat Chalice Guard Denlavis and take the Sealed Goblet to Flamyar at the Fire Temple Entrance. PlayerDefeat Goblet Protector Denlavis in the Fire Temple and find the item that holds Lady Agnita.

24122.title: Mystery of the Missing Daevas
24122.description: Find Pagimkin's Report and take it to Mirka in Alsig Village. PlayerGo to Wonshikutz's Laboratory and find Pagimkin.

24123.title: A Good Mau is Hard to Find
24123.description: Talk with Ananta in Chaikata's Hideout. Destroy the crude prison cell at the Mist Mane Training Ground and free Ishidanti. Report back to Ananta in Chaikata's Hideout. Rescue the Silver Mane Mau Ishidanti who was captured by the Mist Mane Mau.

24150.title: Interior Landscaping
24150.description: Talk with Bestla in the Beluslan Fortress. Talk with Horu who is above the entrance to the Beluslan Fortress. Talk with Nerita in the Beluslan Fortress. There is a risk that the Beluslan fortress might collapse. Discuss this issue with Bestla, a Daeva of Construction.

24151.title: Reclaiming the Damned
24151.description: Talk with Gigrite at the Ghost Village Observation Post. Eradicate the Contaminated Zombies. (5) Return to Gigrite at the Ghost Village Observation Post. The undead problem in the Besfer Ghost Village is quite serious. Meet Gigrite to hear more about it.

24152.title: Through the Looking Glass
24152.description: Talk with Baugi in the Besfer Refugee Camp. Obtain the Quartz Lens from Captain Hinden and take it to Dojer in the Anair Lighthouse. PlayerSleipnir told you to ask Baugi about Alukina's Palace. Go to Baugi.

24153.title: The Efficacy of Fire
24153.description: Talk with Delris in the Ice Tower at the center of Red Mane Cavern. Defeat the Ice Petrahulks. Glaciont the Hardy (1) Frostfist (1) Iceback (1) Chillblow (1) Snowfury (1) Talk with Chieftain Akagitan in Red Mane Cavern. Chieftain Akigatan of the Red Mane Mau said that his tribe is suffering at the hands of the Ice Petrahulks. See Delris to find out how you can help.

24154.title: Better than Last Time
24154.description: Talk with Stua who has infiltrated the Malek Diggings. Disguise yourself as a Lepharist to get through the Secret Port Entrance and enter the Port. Go past the Alquimia Entrance, penetrate into the Daevic Genesis Lab, and destroy the Research Center Power Generator (1). Escape from the research center and send a signal to the Archons with the Signal Flare in the entrance. Report back to Tristran in Beluslan Fortress. There is an important mission regarding the Lephar Revolutionaries. Go see Stua.

24155.title: Leather Wings and Shiny Things
24155.description: Talk with Gwendolin at the Beluslan Observatory. Destroy the Field Suppressors near the Beluslan Observatory. (3). Report back to Hod at the Beluslan Fortress. Carry out the request of Gwendolin who wanders around the Aetheric Field Observatory.

24200.title: Induction to Brusthonin
24200.description: Go to Brusthonin and meet Surt, the Captain of the Reaper Squad. Meet Surt, the leader of the Reaper Squad in Brusthonin, and learn about the situation there.

24201.title: History, Mystery
24201.description: Talk with Theia, who wanders around Baltasar Cemetery. Eliminate Undead Grunts. (12) Report back to Surt in Baltasar Hill Village. Surt asked you to learn more about the Red Sky Legion's fate. Go see Theia.

24202.title: Let Me In, Let Me In
24202.description: Talk with Neligor in Baltasar Hill Village. Talk with Cayron on the Cayron Hill in Iollu Forest. Go to Old Nahor Castle and obtain the Secret Passage Key from a Guard Vampire and then report back to Surt in Baltasar Hill Village. PlayerTalk with Elim Neligor to find a way to enter the Adma Stronghold.

24203.title: Secret of Brusthonin Contamination
24203.description: Talk with Surt. Talk with Sahnu outside of the Old Nahor Castle. Obtain the Spirit Drop in Alukina's Palace and take it to Sahnu outside of the Old Nahor Castle. PlayerTalk with Sahnu. Enter the Adma Stronghold and get rid of the Suspicious Person. [%14] Talk with Heintz in Baltasar Hill Village. Knock on Virkel's Tombstone and call the soul of Virkel. Inform Sigyn. Surt wants you to infiltrate Adma Stronghold. Hear about the mission in detail.

24232.title: Little Help from a Daeva
24232.description: Eliminate the MuMu Looklooks and MuMu Lookouts. (9) Talk with Anmurnerk. Get rid of Mumu Looklooks and Mumu Lookouts in the Mumu Village as Anmurnerk asked so the Traders can expand their business.

24233.title: Adieu to You, Manumumu
24233.description: Eliminate Chieftain Manumumu in the Mumu Village. (1) Report to Suthran. Brodir has been given a mission from the Altgard Fortress to eliminate Chieftain Manumumu of the Mumu Village. He asked you to carry out the mission for him.

24240.title: Wig Out Over the Sprigg Sprout
24240.description: Talk with Lif. Lorando needs help solving the Sprigg problem. Talk with Lif for assistance.

24241.title: You Have a Choice...
24241.description: Talk with Kelmar. Instructor Kelmar is looking for you. Go to Morheim Ice Fortress and talk to him.

24242.title: [Group] All the Spells and Whistles
24242.description: Talk with Bulagan in the Sky Temple of Arkanis. Talk with Flamyar at the Fire Temple Entrance. Defeat Chalice Guard Denlavis and take the Sealed Goblet to Flamyar at the Fire Temple Entrance. PlayerGo see Bulagan about the Fire Temple as Gangleri requested.

24250.title: Time Has Come
24250.description: Meet with Alberich. Agent Fafner announced it's time to assault the Draupnir Cave. Go and talk to Alberich.

24260.title: Invade the Past
24260.description: Talk with Hresvelgr. Ivar said Prophet Hresvelgr in Beluslan is urgently looking for you. Go see Hresvelgr.

24261.title: Back in Time
24261.description: Talk with Hresvelgr. Ivar said Prophet Hresvelgr in Beluslan is urgently looking for you. Go see Hresvelgr.

24270.title: [Group] To Steal a Secret
24270.description: Talk with Alberich in the entrance of Draupnir Cave. Talk with Alberich at Draupnir Cave to obtain the Bio Weapon Sample.

24275.title: [Group] Retribution Resolution
24275.description: Vanquish Kromede the Corrupt in the Fire Temple. (1) Talk with Flamyar at the Fire Temple Entrance. At Flamyar's request, vanquish Kromede, who has taken the Fire Temple.

25082.title: Tyrant Take Out
25082.description: Obtain Bluemane Kirrus Meat and start a fire by putting it on the Captivating Conflagration. PlayerExamine the Captivating Conflagration. Eliminate Scalecrest Kullatu. (1) Report to Wigrick. Eliminate Scalecrest Kullatu.

25084.title: Is This a Trap?
25084.description: Obtain Conchshell Lobnite Meat and take it to Coli. PlayerTalk with Zake. Go to Obscure Point. Report to Bastan. Obtain Conchshell Lobnite's Meat for the Expedition.

25085.title: Intercept the Ide
25085.description: Seize the Ide Crystal and take it to Bastan. PlayerSeize the Ide being transported across the desert by Beritra's troops.

25094.title: An Offering of Friendship
25094.description: Take Hot Balaur Bones to Bekrinerk. PlayerTalk with Bekrinerk. Deliver Bekrinerk's present to Daruku. Obtain Hot Balaur Bones for Bekrinerk so he can offer it to the Tejhi.

25099.title: How the Ship?
25099.description: Talk with Proff. Learn about the current situation from Teleporter Proff.

26908.title: Blast it, Neritra, I'm a Researcher
26908.description: Talk with Svafnir. Kill the Occupation Commander. (1) Talk with Svafnir. Attack and capture the Hoarfrost Watchpost at the Hoarfrost Outpost.

26942.title: A Jump Ahead
26942.description: Use the Linkgate Foundry Corridor to enter Linkgate Foundry and talk with Aitu. Get the Dimension Research Data and a vial of Monster's Blood and bring them to Yasan. PlayerGet the Dimension Research Data and Monster's Blood from Linkgate Foundry and bring them to Tribunus Yasan.

26974.title: To The Bridge
26974.description: Eliminate Spirited Velkur at Ophidan Bridge. (1) Talk with Rohellein. Eliminate Brigade General Velkur and report to Rohellein.

26975.title: A Mysterious Shard
26975.description: Take the fragment you found to Rohellein. Take the fragment you found to Rohellein.

26976.title: Report to the Bridge
26976.description: Talk with Rohellein. Get Velkur's Remnant and take it to Undgankt. PlayerGet Velkur's Remnant at the Ophidan Bridge, and bring it to Undgankt.

28037.title: [Alliance] Defend to the End
28037.description: Defeat Grand Commander Pashid. (1) Talk with Lundvarr. Defeat Governor Pashid at Eternal Bastion.

28412.title: Hidden Quest to Play Cut Scenes (Asmodian)

28917.title: When One Door Closes
28917.description: Talk with Yasan in Levinshor. Talk with Giriltia at Stonepike Falls. Meet with Yasan in Levinshor.

29049.title: [Craft] Construction Basics
29049.description: Make Iron Clamps from Iron Ore and bring them to Darfen. PlayerMake 3 Iron Clamps to prove your ability to Construction Master Darfen.

29051.title: Running the Tables
29051.description: Deliver Darfen's package to Siana in Reshanta. Deliver Darfen's package to Siana in Reshanta's Primum Fortress.

29059.title: Possession Isn't Integrity
29059.description: Take the Round Table to Blir in Reshanta. The Round Table you received is addressed to Blir in Reshanta. Take it to him.

29078.title: Aethertech Master's Test
29078.description: Use [STR_DIC_E_DP_Ri] (10). Report the result to Hadubrant. The DP Test is conducted by the Governor. Use the DP ability Power Flux I ten times to pass the DP Test.

29643.title: Special Mission Request
29643.description: Talk with Richelle in the Gelkmaros Fortress. Go to the Gelkmaros Fortress to meet Richelle.

29644.title: Heading into the Unknown
29644.description: Talk with Haldor in Dragonrest Temple. Go to Enshar and meet Haldor, the Commander of the Expedition.

29645.title: [Daily] A Tidy Supply Route
29645.description: Go to Enshar and eradicate Seasprite Pucas or Small Sea Vortiles. (10) Talk with Haldor in Dragonrest Temple. Eradicate monsters and report to Haldor to receive a Noble Abbey Box Key.

29646.title: Tasks Ahead
29646.description: Talk with Grangund at Dawnbreak Temple. Go to Cygnea and meet with Grangund.

29647.title: [Daily] Assisting Grangund
29647.description: Go to Enshar and eradicate Aurelian Hornskulls or Coralback Ettins. (10) Talk with Grangund at Dawnbreak Temple. Eradicate monsters in Enshar and report to Grangund to receive a Noble Abbey Box Key.

29648.title: Supporting Sefrim
29648.description: Talk with Sefrim at Whirlpool Temple. Go to Whirlpool Temple and meet with Sefrim.

30040.title: Tampering with the Weapon
30040.description: Speak with Gefeios. There is someone who can restore the power of the damaged Siel's Supreme Cipher-Blade. Go meet Gefeios.

30041.title: Restorations
30041.description: Obtain the Noble Cipher-Blade Components and bring it to Gefeios. PlayerObtain the Nox Ingot, a material that can restore the power of Siel's Supreme Cipher-Blade.

30042.title: Reian Relations
30042.description: Talk with Versetti. Talk with Honeus. Go find Honeus and try to improve relations with the Reians.

30142.title: Emissary Errand
30142.description: Speak to Valetta. Talk with Aglauros. Relations with the Reians must be improved in order for the Asmodians to secure Gelkmaros. Go find Aglauros in Marayas Wilds and ask if you can assist him.

30250.title: [Group] A New Weapon
30250.description: Gather Blessed Cipher-Blade Components and use the furnace at Debilkarim's Forge to process them. PlayerThen take Siel's Essence to Gefeios. You can take Noble Siel's Supreme Cipher-Blade to new levels by enhancing it. Gather up materials and refine them at Jotun Studio to do this.

30350.title: [Group] A Better Weapon
30350.description: Gather the Blessed Cipher-Blade Components and use the furnace at Debilkarim's Forge to process them. PlayerTake Siel's Essence to Tataka. You can enhance Noble Siel's Supreme Cipher-Blade. Gather up the materials and refine them at Debilkarim's Forge.

39600.title: Silvers Cross Your Palm
39600.description: Talk with Danurinerk. Silverine Ltd. is looking for new employees. Talk with Danurinerk, a recruiter.

39700.title: Introducing The Merry and Green
39700.description: Talk with Manurunerk. The Merry and Green is recruiting new members. Let's meet Manurunerk.

41600.title: Going on a Monster Hunt
41600.description: Eliminate one of the Strong Creatures in the Fissure Barrens. (1) Talk to Solteria. Strong creatures in the Fissure Barrens are causing trouble. Eliminate Whirling Augusta, Sailing Tumer, Haunting Kakaro, Wallowing Garnetis, or Clero the Wanderer.

41601.title: Picking a Mark
41601.description: Kill one of the Trouble in the Land of Gravity (1). Talk with Ur. Help Ur out by claiming one of the bounties he'd set, thereby showing the other hunters that they aren't all that powerful.

41602.title: Besieged by Peril
41602.description: Eliminate a Dangerous Foe in the Fields of Fire or Avad Village (1). Talk to Rador. Rador needs some breathing room from the constant peril surrounding him. Help him by taking down Burning Urstan, Tempestuous Ardor, Tindertryst, Taida the Enraged, or Reclusive Krata.

41603.title: Stay On Target
41603.description: Kill one of the Headache (1). Report back to Wesley. There are Sandstorm Targets in the Calcified Trundra and Siel's Temple Ruins, including Pounding Tatamo, Jeweloop Vitale, Flame Mane Firzan, Ancient Elder Ermus, and Resounding Corrus.

41604.title: Not For Teacher!
41604.description: Eliminate an Instructor in the Balaur Cavalry Base (1). Report to Solteria. Kill either Sergeant Darsa or Training Instructor Karan, Drakan who are training troops at the Balaur Cavalry Base.

41605.title: Headhunting
41605.description: Kill one of the Naduka Legion Heads (1). Report back to Ur. Ur needs one of the Naduka Legion heads killed. Take out either Deputy Brigade General Lucarn or Aide Kaimar.

41606.title: Kill the Head, Kill the Body
41606.description: Kill a Basrasa Legion Head (1). Talk to Rador. The Basrasa Legion must be weakened. Kill either Combat Captain Danika or Deputy Brigade General Kutma.

41607.title: Getting a Head
41607.description: Kill one of the Satra Legion Heads (1). Report back to Wesley. Wesley thinks a decisive strike at the Satra Legion is due, so take out either Deputy Brigade General Talaba or Bodyguard Captain Daira.

41608.title: [Group] The Kill List
41608.description: Assassinate one of the Balaur Brigade Generals (1). Report back to Ur. Kill one of the Balaur Brigade Generals and send a message to the Balaur that you cannot be stopped.

41609.title: [Group] A Helping Hand
41609.description: Eliminate a Formidable Creature in Gurriki Swamp or the Siege Troop Garrison (1). Report to Rador. Rador asked you to kill a formidable foe in Gurriki Swamp or the Siege Troop Garrison. Track and slay Merciless Lamaz, Kichikor the Militant, Colossal Geodenos, Crystaltusk Erubes, or Rumbling Enzique.

41610.title: [Group] Balaur's Greatest Hits
41610.description: Kill one of the Protectorate Heads (1). Report back to Wesley. Deputy Brigade General Asitan or Assault Team Leader Kunati are Satra Legion generals. Without them, the Legion will falter.

41611.title: [Group] High Command
41611.description: Eliminate one of the Protectorate High Command in Tiamaranta's Eye (1). Report back to Wesley. The Balaur Protectorate Legion's High Command, including Aide Iranati, Deputy Governor Brilla, Master-at-arms Ranigan, and Captain Granta, are among the most vital--and dangerous--Sandstorm targets.

41612.title: [Alliance] Morale Booster
41612.description: Defeat one of Tiamat's Monsters (1). Report to Solteria. You promised to defeat one of the creatures empowered by Dragon Lord Tiamat: Cavalry Chief Tagata, Continuum Guardian Arachi, or Ativas Crystalline.

41613.title: [Alliance] Colossal Chaos
41613.description: Kill one of the Giant Creature of Tiamaranta (1). Report back to Wesley. Wesley has some colossal Targets in Tiamarata which cannot be trusted to an average Daeva.

41614.title: [Alliance] Personal Incarnation
41614.description: Eliminate one of Tiamat's Incarnations (1). Report to Solteria. Much of Tiamat's power is invested in his Incarnations. Defeat any one of Fissure Incarnate, Gravity Incarnate, Wrath Incarnate, or Petrification Incarnate.

41615.title: [Daily] Target Acquisition
41615.description: Kill one of the Troublesome Creatures (1). Report back to Jupitor. There's a long list of Sandstorm Targets waiting for you: Whirling Augusta, Sailing Tumer, Haunting Kakaro, Wallowing Garnetis, Clero the Wanderer, Budding Jejune, Raging Phernind, Noble Asteris, Dancing Dagger Serion, and Danitur the Renegade.

41616.title: [Weekly] Creature of Wrath and Petrification
41616.description: Eliminate one of the Violent Creatures (1). Report back to Jupitor. Jupitor has a long list of Sandstorm Targets for you: Burning Urstan, Tempestuous Ardor, Tindertryst, Taida the Enraged, Reclusive Krata, Pounding Tatamo, Jeweloop Vitale, Flameclaw Firzan, Ancient Elder Ermus, and Resounding Corrus.

41617.title: [Weekly] Cavalry Charge
41617.description: Eliminate one of the Balaur Cavalry Base Instructors (1). Report back to Daisha. The instructors at the Balaur Cavalry Base pose a serious threat to Rancora Fortress.

41618.title: Aides, de-Camped
41618.description: Eliminate one of the Balaur Legion Generalss (1). Report back to Daisha. Daisha wants to test your mettle on some high-level Targets: Deputy Brigade General Lucarn or Aide Kaimar of the Naduka Legion, Combat Captain Danika or Deputy Brigade General Kutma of the Basrasa Legion, or Deputy Brigade General Talaba or Bodyguard Captain Daira of the Satra Legion.

41619.title: [Weekly/Group] Menacing Creature
41619.description: Eliminate one of the Balaur Brigade Generals or Formidable Creatures (1). Report back to Jupitor. Jupitor has another long list of Sandstorm Targets for you: Brigade General Naduka, Brigade General Basrasa, Brigade General Satra, Merciless Lamaz, Kichikor the Militant, Colossal Geodenos, Crystaltusk Erubes, and Rumbling Enzique.

41620.title: [Weekly/Group] The Protectorate
41620.description: Defeat one of the Protectorate Lordss (1). Report back to Daisha. The Protectorate Heads in Basilika Cavern and Tiamaranta's Eye must be eliminated.

41621.title: [Weekly/Alliance] Monstrous Problems
41621.description: Eliminate one of the Monstrous Threats (1). Report back to Daisha. The Sandstorm has identified some monstrous Targets in Tiamaranta: Cavalry Chief Tagata, Continuum Guardian Arachi, Ruthless Ossek, and Noble Ricid.

41622.title: [Alliance] Target Incarnate
41622.description: Take down one of Tiamat's Incarnations (1). Report back to Daisha. All of Tiamat's Incarnations are Sandstorm Targets, threats to Reian stability.

49600.title: Silverine's Silver Lining
49600.description: Talk with Dumurinerk. Silverine Ltd. is looking for new employees. Speak with the recruiter, Dumurinerk.

49700.title: Meet the Merry and Green
49700.description: Talk with Sununnerk of The Merry and Green. The Merry and Green is currently recruiting new members for the cause. Let's meet Sununnerk.
